title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七 德宗 順宗 憲宗 Volume 7 Annals 7: Dezong, Shunzong, Xianzong

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__德宗德宗神武聖文皇帝諱适，代宗長子也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Emperor Dezong, Emperor Dezong the Divine Martial and Sagely Civil, taboo name Shi, was the eldest son of Daizong.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Emperor Dezong, posthumously honored as the Divine Martial and Sagely Civil, bore the taboo name Shi and was the eldest son of Daizong.

sentences.zh: 母曰睿真皇太后沈氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Ruizhen of the Shen clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Ruizhen, née Shen.

sentences.zh: 初，沈氏以開元末選入代宗宮。

translations.literal: At first the Shen clan in the late Kaiyuan period was selected into Daizong's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Originally, Lady Shen was selected into Daizong's household in the late Kaiyuan era.

sentences.zh: 安祿山之亂，玄宗避賊于蜀，諸王妃妾不及從者，皆為賊所得，拘之東都之掖廷。

translations.literal: In An Lushan's rebellion Xuanzong avoided the rebels in Shu; consorts and concubines of the princes who could not follow were all taken by the rebels and detained in the rear palace of the eastern capital.
translations.idiomatic: During An Lushan's rebellion, Xuanzong fled to Shu. Imperial consorts and concubines who could not accompany him were seized by the rebels and held in the rear palace at the eastern capital.

sentences.zh: 代宗克東都，得沈氏，留之宮中；

translations.literal: When Daizong took the eastern capital he obtained the Shen clan and kept her in the palace;
translations.idiomatic: When Daizong recovered the eastern capital he found Lady Shen and kept her at court;

sentences.zh: 史思明再陷東都，遂失所在。

translations.literal: when Shi Siming again took the eastern capital she was lost and her whereabouts unknown.
translations.idiomatic: when Shi Siming seized the eastern capital again she disappeared without trace.

sentences.zh: 肅宗元年建丑月，封德宗奉節郡王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Suzong, in the month jianchou, Dezong was enfeoffed as Prince of Fengjie commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Suzong 1, month jianchou, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Fengjie.

sentences.zh: 代宗即位，史朝義據東都，乃以德宗為天下兵馬元帥，進封魯王。

translations.literal: When Daizong ascended the throne Shi Chaoyi held the eastern capital; Dezong was then made supreme commander of all military forces under heaven and advanced to Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: After Daizong's accession, with Shi Chaoyi holding the eastern capital, he was appointed supreme commander of armies under heaven and promoted to Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 八月，徙封雍王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month his fief was moved to Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was transferred to Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 寶應元年十月，屯于陝州，諸將進擊史朝義，敗之，朝義走河北，遂克東都。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Baoying he encamped at Shaan prefecture; the generals advanced to attack Shi Chaoyi, defeated him, Chaoyi fled to Hebei, and the eastern capital was then taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Baoying 1 he encamped at Shaan. His generals attacked Shi Chaoyi, routed him, and Chaoyi fled to Hebei; the eastern capital was recovered.

sentences.zh: 十一月，史朝義死幽州，守將李懷仙斬其首來獻，河北平。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Shi Chaoyi died at You prefecture; the defending general Li Huaixian beheaded him and presented the head; Hebei was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Shi Chaoyi died at You. The garrison commander Li Huaixian sent his severed head; Hebei was pacified.

sentences.zh: 以功兼尚書令，與功臣郭子儀、李光弼等皆賜鐵券，圖形凌烟閣。

translations.literal: For merit he was additionally made director of the Department of State Affairs; with meritorious ministers Guo Ziyi, Li Guangbi, and others he was all granted iron certificates and his image placed in Lingyan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was also made director of the Department of State Affairs. He and meritorious ministers such as Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi received iron certificates, and their portraits were hung in Lingyan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 廣德二年二月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Guangde he was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangde 2 he was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 大曆十四年五月辛酉，代宗崩。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourteenth year of Dali, on the day xinyou, Daizong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dali 14, on xinyou, Daizong died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，即皇帝位于太極殿。

translations.literal: On the day guihai he ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，貶常衮為河南少尹，以河南少尹崔祐甫為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day jiaxu Chang Gun was demoted to vice prefect of Henan; the vice prefect of Henan Cui Youfu was made vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on jiaxu Chang Gun was demoted to vice prefect of Henan, and Cui Youfu, vice prefect of Henan, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷諸州府及新羅、渤海貢鷹鷂。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi tribute of hawks and falcons from all prefectures and from Silla and Bohai was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi tribute of hawks and falcons from prefectures, Silla, and Bohai was ended.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷山南貢枇杷、江南甘橘非供宗廟者。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin tribute of loquats from Shannan and sweet oranges from Jiangnan not for the ancestral temple was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Shannan loquats and Jiangnan sweet oranges not reserved for the ancestral temple were struck from tribute lists.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷邕府歲貢奴婢。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the annual tribute of slave girls from Yong prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yong's annual tribute of slave girls was abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷梨園樂工三百人、劍南貢生春酒。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei three hundred Pear Garden musicians and Jiannan's tribute of raw spring wine were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei three hundred Pear Garden musicians were dismissed and Jiannan's tribute of raw spring wine was ended.

sentences.zh: 甲申，郭子儀為尚父，兼太尉、中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Guo Ziyi was made Imperial Father and additionally grand mentor and secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Guo Ziyi was named Imperial Father and also appointed grand mentor and secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，罷獻祥瑞，貢器以金銀飾者還之。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu presentation of auspicious omens was abolished, and tribute vessels with gold and silver ornament were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the court stopped accepting auspicious omens and returned tribute vessels decorated with gold or silver.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，出宮人，放舞象三十有二于荊山之陽。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai palace women were released and thirty-two dancing elephants were set free on the south slope of Jing Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai palace women were released and thirty-two trained elephants were freed on the southern slope of Jing Mountain.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，大赦。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jihai there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jihai a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵，民為戶者古爵一級。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles; commoners registered as households received one ancient noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials received ranks and titles; registered households were raised one ancient noble rank.

sentences.zh: 減乘輿服御。

translations.literal: Imperial carriage apparel and supplies were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reduced his carriage regalia and household supplies.

sentences.zh: 士庶田宅、車服踰制者，有司為立法度。

translations.literal: Where gentry and commoners' fields, dwellings, carriages, and apparel exceeded regulations, the relevant offices were to set legal standards.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were ordered to codify limits on land, housing, carriages, and dress for gentry and commoners who exceeded statute.

sentences.zh: 禁百官置邸販鬻。

translations.literal: Officials were forbidden to set up lodges for trade.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were forbidden to maintain lodges for commercial trade.

sentences.zh: 武德、至德將相有功者子孫予官。

translations.literal: Descendants of chancellors and generals with merit in the Wude and Zhide eras were given office.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of meritorious Wude and Zhide chancellors and generals were granted office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，進封子宣城郡王誦為宣王，封子謨為舒王，諶通王，諒虔王，詳肅王，謙資王。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi the son Prince of Xuancheng commandery Song was advanced to Prince of Xuan; the sons Mo was enfeoffed Prince of Shu, Chen Prince of Tong, Liang Prince of Qian, Xiang Prince of Su, and Qian Prince of Zi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi his son Song, Prince of Xuancheng, was promoted to Prince of Xuan; Mo was enfeoffed Prince of Shu, Chen Prince of Tong, Liang Prince of Qian, Xiang Prince of Su, and Qian Prince of Zi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，封弟迺為益王，迅隋王，遂蜀王。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the younger brother Nai was enfeoffed Prince of Yi, Xun Prince of Sui, and Sui Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi his younger brothers Nai, Xun, and Sui were enfeoffed as Princes of Yi, Sui, and Shu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔六品以上清望官，日二人待制。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu it was decreed that among clear-reputation officials of the sixth rank and above, two each day would attend on call.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court ordered two eminent officials of the sixth rank or higher to attend on call each day.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命皇族五等以上居四方者，家一人赴山陵。

translations.literal: On the day guichou it was ordered that among the imperial clan of the fifth rank and above residing in the four directions, one person per household should go to the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou one member of each fifth-rank-or-higher princely house living away from the capital was ordered to attend the imperial burial.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷揚州貢鏡、幽州貢麝。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei tribute of mirrors from Yang prefecture and musk from You prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yang's mirror tribute and You's musk tribute were abolished.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，舉可刺史、京令者。

translations.literal: On the day guihai persons fit to be prefects or capital magistrates were recommended.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the court called for nominations of men fit to serve as prefects or capital magistrates.

sentences.zh: 七月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the first day of the month wuchen there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, wuchen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚午，弛邕州金坑禁。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu prohibitions on Yong prefecture's gold mines were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu restrictions on Yong's gold mines were lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，罷榷酤。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao government monopoly on wine was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the wine monopoly was abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，道州司馬楊炎為門下侍郎，懷州刺史喬琳為御史大夫：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiachen the Dao prefecture aide Yang Yan was made vice director of the Chancellery and the Huai prefecture inspector Qiao Lin censor-in-chief: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiachen Yang Yan, aide of Dao prefecture, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery, and Qiao Lin, inspector of Huai, censor-in-chief—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，還吐蕃俘。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Tibetan captives were returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Tibetan prisoners were repatriated.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，吐蕃、雲南蠻寇黎、茂、文、扶四州，鳳翔節度使朱泚、金吾衞大將軍曲環敗之于七盤城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou Tibet and Yunnan barbarians raided the four prefectures Li, Mao, Wen, and Fu; the Fengxiang military commissioner Zhu Ci and the great general of the Golden Crow Guard Qu Huan defeated them at Seven Passes city.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingyou Tibetans and Yunnan tribes raided Li, Mao, Wen, and Fu. Fengxiang commissioner Zhu Ci and Golden Crow Guard general Qu Huan defeated them at Qipan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬睿文孝武皇帝于元陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the Sagely Civil and Filial Martial emperor was buried at Yuan tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Daizong was buried at Yuan Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷九成宮貢立獸炭、襄州蔗蒻工。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu tribute of standing-animal charcoal from Jiucheng Palace and Jiannan rush-mat craftsmen from Xiang prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu tribute of ceremonial charcoal from Jiucheng Palace and Xiang's rush-mat craftsmen was ended.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以沙苑豢豕三千給貧民。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou three thousand pigs raised at Shayan were given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou three thousand pigs from the Shayan herd were distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，喬琳罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renwu Qiao Lin was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renwu Qiao Lin was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，立宣王誦為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yimao Prince of Xuan Song was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yimao Prince of Xuan Song was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丙寅晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the last day of the month bingyin there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the month, bingyin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 建中元年正月丁卯，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Jianzhong on the day dingmao the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Jianzhong 1, on dingmao, the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 羣臣上尊號曰聖神文武皇帝。

translations.literal: The ministers presented a honorific title saying Sagely Divine Civil and Martial emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers offered the honorific Sagely Divine Civil and Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: On the day jisi he made offering at the Supreme Clear palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he offered at the Supreme Clear Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he made offering at the Imperial Ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有事于南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei he performed the suburban sacrifice; there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he performed the southern suburban rite and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，遣黜陟使于天下，賜子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit records, and titles; inspection envoys were sent throughout the realm; sons who succeeded fathers received two merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: Officials received ranks, merit records, and titles; inspection envoys were dispatched empire-wide; sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，初定兩稅。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day bingshen the two-tax system was first fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on bingshen the two-tax system was instituted.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，四鎮、北庭行軍別駕劉文喜反于涇州，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yiwei the Four Garrisons and Northern Frontier campaign vice prefect Liu Wenxi rebelled at Jing prefecture and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yiwei Liu Wenxi, vice prefect of the Four Garrisons and Northern Frontier campaign, rebelled at Jing and was executed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，地震。

translations.literal: On the day jihai there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，崔祐甫薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiawu Cui Youfu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiawu Cui Youfu died.

sentences.zh: 七月丙寅，王國良降。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day bingyin Wang Guoliang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingyin Wang Guoliang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己丑，殺忠州刺史劉晏。

translations.literal: On the day jichou the prefect of Zhong Liu Yan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Liu Yan, prefect of Zhong, was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，遙尊母沈氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingsi his mother the Shen clan was honored from afar as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingsi his mother Lady Shen was honored from afar as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，雷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jimao there was thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jimao thunder was heard.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，睦王述為奉迎皇太后使。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Prince of Mu Shu was made envoy to welcome the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince of Mu Shu was appointed envoy to welcome the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter no snow fell.

sentences.zh: 黃河、滹沱、易水溢。

translations.literal: The Yellow River, Hutuo, and Yishui overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River, Hutuo, and Yishui flooded.

sentences.zh: 二年正月戊辰，成德軍節度使李寶臣卒，其子惟岳自稱留後，幽州盧龍軍節度使朱滔討之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day wuchen the Chengde army military commissioner Li Baochen died; his son Weiyue styled himself acting commissioner; the Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Zhu Tao campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on wuchen, Li Baochen, commissioner of Chengde, died. His son Weiyue declared himself acting commissioner; Zhu Tao of Lulong campaigned against him.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度使田悅反，神策都虞候李晟、河東節度使馬燧、昭義軍節度使李抱真、河陽節度副使李芃討之。

translations.literal: The Weibo military commissioner Tian Yue rebelled; the Shence chief aide Li Sheng, the Hedong military commissioner Ma Sui, the Zhaoyi army military commissioner Li Baozhen, and the Heyang deputy commissioner Li Peng campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: Weibo commissioner Tian Yue rebelled. Li Sheng, chief aide of the Shence Army; Ma Sui of Hedong; Li Baozhen of Zhaoyi; and Li Peng, deputy commissioner of Heyang, were sent against him.

sentences.zh: 永平軍節度使李勉為汴、滑、陳、懷、鄭、汝、陝、河陽三城、宋、亳、潁節度都統。

translations.literal: The Yongping army military commissioner Li Mian was made overall commander of the Bian, Hua, Chen, Huai, Zheng, Ru, Shan, Heyang Three Cities, Song, Bo, and Ying circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mian, commissioner of Yongping, was made overall commander of Bian, Hua, Chen, Huai, Zheng, Ru, Shan, the Heyang Three Cities, Song, Bo, and Ying.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，御史大夫盧𣏌為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yisi the censor-in-chief Lu Qi was made vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yisi Lu Qi was appointed censor-in-chief, vice director of the Chancellery, and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，振武軍亂，殺其使彭令芳及監軍劉惠光。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the Zhenwu army mutinied and killed its commissioner Peng Lingfang and the supervising army Liu Huiguang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the Zhenwu army mutinied, killing commissioner Peng Lingfang and army supervisor Liu Huiguang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，發兵屯關東，誓師于望春樓。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi troops were dispatched to garrison east of the pass and the army was sworn in at Wangchun tower.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi armies were sent to garrison east of Tong Pass and troops were sworn in at Wangchun Tower.

sentences.zh: 山南東道節度使梁崇義反。

translations.literal: The Shannan East circuit military commissioner Liang Chongyi rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Chongyi, commissioner of Shannan East, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 五月，京師雨雹。

translations.literal: In the fifth month hail fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month hail struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，置待詔官三十人。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen thirty attendance-on-call officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen thirty attendance-on-call posts were created.

sentences.zh: 六月，熒惑、太白鬬于東井。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Mars and Venus battled at the Well mansion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Mars and Venus were in conjunction at the Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，淮寧軍節度使李希烈為漢南、漢北兵馬招討使，以討梁崇義。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the Huaining army military commissioner Li Xilie was made commander to recruit troops of south and north Han and to campaign against Liang Chongyi.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Xilie, commissioner of Huaining, was made commander of Han south and north armies to campaign against Liang Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，郭子儀薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Guo Ziyi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Guo Ziyi died.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，楊炎罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengshen Yang Yan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengshen Yang Yan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 檢校尚書右僕射侯希逸為司空，前永平軍節度使張鎰為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs Hou Xiyi was made minister of works; the former Yongping army military commissioner Zhang Yi was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiyi, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made minister of works; Zhang Yi, former Yongping commissioner, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 侯希逸薨。

translations.literal: Hou Xiyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Xiyi died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，馬燧、李抱真及田悅戰于臨洺，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Ma Sui, Li Baozhen, and Tian Yue fought at Linming and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Ma Sui and Li Baozhen defeated Tian Yue at Linming.

sentences.zh: 八月，劍南西川節度使張延賞、東川節度使王叔邕、山南東道節度使賈耽、荊南節度使李昌巙、陳少游討梁崇義，以李希烈為諸軍都統。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Zhang Yanshang, the East circuit military commissioner Wang Shuyong, the Shannan East circuit military commissioner Jia Dan, the Jingnan military commissioner Li Changchao, and Chen Shaoyou campaigned against Liang Chongyi; Li Xilie was made overall commander of the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Zhang Yanshang of western Sichuan, Wang Shuyong of eastern Sichuan, Jia Dan of Shannan East, Li Changchao of Jingnan, and Chen Shaoyou campaigned against Liang Chongyi, with Li Xilie as overall commander.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，平盧軍節度使李正己卒，其子納自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Pinglu army military commissioner Li Zhengyi died; his son Na styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Zhengyi, commissioner of Pinglu, died; his son Na declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬子，梁崇義伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Liang Chongyi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liang Chongyi was executed.

sentences.zh: 九月，李納陷宋州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Li Na took Song prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Li Na captured Song.

sentences.zh: 李惟岳將張孝忠以易、定二州降。

translations.literal: Li Weiyue's general Zhang Xiaozhong surrendered with Yi and Ding prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xiaozhong, a general of Li Weiyue, surrendered Yi and Ding.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜立功士卒帛，稟死事家三歲。

translations.literal: On the day renxu meritorious soldiers were given silk; families of the dead were provisioned for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu troops who had earned merit received silk, and families of the fallen were provisioned for three years.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，李納將李洧以徐州降。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day wushen Li Na's general Li Xu surrendered with Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on wushen Li Xu, a general of Li Na, surrendered Xu.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，納寇徐州，宣武軍節度使劉洽敗之于七里溝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinyou Na raided Xu prefecture; the Xuanwu army military commissioner Liu Qia defeated him at Qiligou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinyou Li Na attacked Xu; Liu Qia of Xuanwu defeated him at Qiligou.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，馬燧及田悅戰于雙岡，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Ma Sui and Tian Yue fought at Shuanggang and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Ma Sui defeated Tian Yue at Shuanggang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，李納將王涉以海州降。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Li Na's general Wang She surrendered with Hai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wang She, a general of Li Na, surrendered Hai.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，馬萬通以密州降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingyou Ma Wantong surrendered with Mi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingyou Ma Wantong surrendered Mi.

sentences.zh: 馬燧為魏博招討使。

translations.literal: Ma Sui was made commander to recruit troops of Weibo.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui was appointed commander to campaign against Weibo.

sentences.zh: 是歲，殺崖州司馬楊炎。

translations.literal: That year the Ya prefecture aide Yang Yan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Yan, aide of Ya prefecture, was executed.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙寅，朱滔、成德軍節度使張孝忠及李惟岳戰于束鹿，敗之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day bingyin Zhu Tao, the Chengde army military commissioner Zhang Xiaozhong, and Li Weiyue fought at Shulu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on bingyin, Zhu Tao, Zhang Xiaozhong of Chengde, and Li Weiyue fought at Shulu and defeated Weiyue.

sentences.zh: 辛未，減常膳及太子諸王食物。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei regular meals and food for the heir apparent and princes were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court reduced the emperor's regular meals and provisions for the heir apparent and princes.

sentences.zh: 復榷酤。

translations.literal: Government monopoly on wine was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The wine monopoly was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李納陷海、密二州。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei Li Na took Hai and Mi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Na captured Hai and Mi.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，李惟岳將康日知以趙州降。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day yiwei Li Weiyue's general Kang Rizhi surrendered with Zhao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on yiwei Kang Rizhi, a general of Li Weiyue, surrendered Zhao.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，惟岳伏誅，其將楊榮國以深州降。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Weiyue was executed; his general Yang Rongguo surrendered with Shen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Weiyue was executed; Yang Rongguo, one of his generals, surrendered Shen.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，馬燧及田悅戰于洹水，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Ma Sui and Tian Yue fought at Huanshui and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Ma Sui defeated Tian Yue at Huanshui.

sentences.zh: 是月，悅將李再春以博州降，田昂以洺州降。

translations.literal: That month Tian Yue's general Li Zaichun surrendered with Bo prefecture; Tian Ang surrendered with Ming prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Zaichun, a general of Tian Yue, surrendered Bo; Tian Ang surrendered Ming.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，李惟岳將楊政義以定州降。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day wuwu Li Weiyue's general Yang Zhengyi surrendered with Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on wuwu Yang Zhengyi, a general of Li Weiyue, surrendered Ding.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，給復易、定、深、趙、恆、冀六州三年，赦吏民為李惟岳迫脅者。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu tax relief was granted to the six prefectures Yi, Ding, Shen, Zhao, Heng, and Ji for three years; officials and people compelled by Li Weiyue were amnestied.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Yi, Ding, Shen, Zhao, Heng, and Ji received three years' tax relief, and subjects coerced by Li Weiyue were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 己卯，震通化門。

translations.literal: On the day jimao there was an earthquake at Tonghua gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an earthquake struck Tonghua Gate.

sentences.zh: 四月戊午，李納將李士真以德、棣二州降。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuwu Li Na's general Li Shizhen surrendered with De and Di prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuwu Li Shizhen, a general of Li Na, surrendered De and Di.

sentences.zh: 甲子，借商錢。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi merchant money was borrowed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court borrowed against merchant funds.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，昭義軍節度副使盧玄卿為魏博、澶相招討使。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu the Zhaoyi army deputy commissioner Lu Xuanqing was made commander to recruit troops of Weibo and Cao and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Lu Xuanqing, deputy commissioner of Zhaoyi, was appointed commander against Weibo and Cao-Xiang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，張鎰罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Zhang Yi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Zhang Yi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，殺殿中侍御史鄭詹。

translations.literal: On the day renwu the palace aide censor Zheng Zhan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu palace aide censor Zheng Zhan was executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，朱滔反，陷德、棣二州。

translations.literal: That month Zhu Tao rebelled and took De and Di prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhu Tao rebelled and captured De and Di.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，朔方軍節度使李懷光討田悅。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinmao the Shuofang army military commissioner Li Huaiguang campaigned against Tian Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinmao Li Huaiguang of Shuofang was sent against Tian Yue.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiazi the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiazi an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 恆冀觀察使王武俊反。

translations.literal: The Heng-Ji observation commissioner Wang Wujun rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wujun, observation commissioner of Heng-Ji, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，李懷光、馬燧、李芃、李抱真及朱滔、王武俊、田悅戰于連篋山，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Li Huaiguang, Ma Sui, Li Peng, Li Baozhen, and Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue fought at Lianjianshan and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Li Huaiguang, Ma Sui, Li Peng, and Li Baozhen fought Zhu Tao, Wang Wujun, and Tian Yue at Lianjianshan and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，殿中丞李雲端謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renchen the palace aide Li Yunduan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renchen palace aide Li Yunduan plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，停借商錢令。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the order to borrow merchant money was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the merchant-loan order was rescinded.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，演州司馬李孟秋、峯州刺史皮岸反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guichou the Yan prefecture aide Li Mengqiu and the Feng prefecture inspector Pi An rebelled and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guichou Li Mengqiu, aide of Yan, and Pi An, inspector of Feng, rebelled and were executed.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，初稅商錢、茶、漆、竹、木。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dinghai merchant money, tea, lacquer, bamboo, and timber were first taxed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dinghai taxes on merchant funds, tea, lacquer, bamboo, and timber were instituted.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，吏部侍郎關播為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingchen the vice minister of the civil service Guan Bo was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingchen Guan Bo, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 李希烈反。

translations.literal: Li Xilie rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xilie rebelled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，肅王詳薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Prince of Su Xiang died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Prince of Su Xiang died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月丁亥，鳳翔節度使張鎰及吐蕃尚結贊盟于清水。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year on the day dinghai the Fengxiang military commissioner Zhang Yi and the Tibetan minister Jiezan allied at Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on dinghai, Zhang Yi of Fengxiang allied with the Tibetan minister Jiezan at Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，李希烈陷汝州，執刺史李元平。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin Li Xilie took Ru prefecture and seized the prefect Li Yuanping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Li Xilie captured Ru and seized Prefect Li Yuanping.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，東都、汝行營節度使哥舒曜討李希烈。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu the eastern capital and Ru campaign military commissioner Geshu Yao campaigned against Li Xilie.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Geshu Yao, commissioner of the eastern capital and Ru campaign, was sent against Li Xilie.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，克汝州。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingmao Ru prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingmao Ru was recovered.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，李希烈寇鄂州，刺史李兼敗之。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinmao Li Xilie raided E prefecture; the prefect Li Jian defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinmao Li Xilie raided E; Prefect Li Jian repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，荊南節度使張伯儀及李希烈戰于安州，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the Jingnan military commissioner Zhang Boyi and Li Xilie fought at An prefecture and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Zhang Boyi of Jingnan fought Li Xilie at An and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，李勉為淮西招討處置使，哥舒曜副之；

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengshen Li Mian was made commander to recruit and dispose troops of Huai West; Geshu Yao was deputy;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengshen Li Mian was made commander to recruit and dispose Huai West forces, with Geshu Yao as deputy;

sentences.zh: 張伯儀為淮西應援招討使，賈耽、江南西道節度使嗣曹王皐副之。

translations.literal: Zhang Boyi was made commander to recruit supporting troops of Huai West; Jia Dan and the Jiangnan West circuit military commissioner the Prince of Cao Gao were deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Boyi was made supporting commander for Huai West, with Jia Dan and Prince of Cao Gao of Jiangnan West as deputies.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京師地震，生毛。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the capital earthquake; hair grew.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the capital was shaken and hair sprouted from the ground.

sentences.zh: 丙子，哥舒曜及李希烈戰于潁橋，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Geshu Yao and Li Xilie fought at Ying bridge and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Geshu Yao defeated Li Xilie at Ying Bridge.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinsi the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinsi another earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，潁王璬薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou Prince of Ying Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Prince of Ying Hao died.

sentences.zh: 乙未，劉洽為淄青、兗鄆招討制置使。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Liu Qia was made commander to recruit and dispose troops of Zi-Qing and Yan-Yun.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Qia was appointed commander to recruit and dispose Zi-Qing and Yan-Yun forces.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，稅屋間架，算除陌錢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day gengxu tax on inter-column space of houses was levied and removal of exchange-fee money was calculated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on gengxu a tax on built floor space was levied and exchange-fee money was assessed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，徙封逾為丹王，遘簡王。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao the fief of Yu was moved to Prince of Dan and Gou to Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yu was transferred to Prince of Dan and Gou to Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 七月，馬燧為魏博、澶相節度招討使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Ma Sui was made military commissioner to recruit troops of Weibo and Cao and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Ma Sui was made commissioner to campaign against Weibo and Cao-Xiang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，盧𣏌、關播、李忠臣及吐蕃區頰贊盟于京師。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Lu Qi, Guan Bo, Li Zhongchen, and the Tibetan Qu Pizan allied at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Lu Qi, Guan Bo, Li Zhongchen, and the Tibetan Qu Pizan concluded an alliance at the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月丁未，李希烈寇襄城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingwei Li Xilie raided Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingwei Li Xilie raided Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，希烈將曹季昌以隋州降。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Li Xilie's general Cao Jichang surrendered with Sui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Cao Jichang, a general of Li Xilie, surrendered Sui.

sentences.zh: 庚申，有星隕于京師。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen a star fell in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen a meteor fell within the capital.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，神策軍行營兵馬使劉德信及李希烈戰于扈澗，敗績。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingxu the Shence army campaign horse-and-army envoy Liu Dexin and Li Xilie fought at Hujian and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingxu Liu Dexin of the Shence campaign army fought Li Xilie at Hujian and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 庚子，舒王謨為荊襄、江西、沔鄂節度諸軍行營兵馬都元帥，徙封普王。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Prince of Shu Mo was made supreme commander of the Jing-Xiang, Jiangxi, Mian-E, and E circuits campaign; the fief of Pu was moved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Prince of Shu Mo was made supreme commander of the Jing-Xiang, Jiangxi, Mian-E, and E campaign; Pu's fief was transferred.

sentences.zh: 十月，涇原節度使姚令言反，犯京師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Jingyuan military commissioner Yao Lingyan rebelled and invaded the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Yao Lingyan of Jingyuan rebelled and stormed the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，如奉天。

translations.literal: On the day wushen he went to Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor withdrew to Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 朱泚反。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci rebelled.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，泚殺司農卿段秀實及左驍衞將軍劉海賓。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Ci killed the minister of the imperial granaries Duan Xiushi and the left valiant guard general Liu Haibin.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Zhu Ci executed Duan Xiushi, minister of the imperial granaries, and Liu Haibin, general of the left valiant guard.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔後營將李楚琳殺其節度使張鎰，自稱留後。

translations.literal: The Fengxiang rear-camp general Li Chulin killed his military commissioner Zhang Yi and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chulin, a Fengxiang rear-camp officer, killed commissioner Zhang Yi and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，李希烈陷襄城，宣武軍兵馬使高翼死之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Li Xilie took Xiangcheng; the Xuanwu army horse-and-army envoy Gao Yi died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Li Xilie captured Xiangcheng; Gao Yi of Xuanwu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朱泚殺涇原節度都虞候何明禮。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Ci killed the Jingyuan army chief aide He Mingli.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Zhu Ci executed He Mingli, chief aide of Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，殺尚書右僕射崔寧。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the right vice director of the Department of State Affairs Cui Ning was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Cui Ning, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，戶部尚書蕭復為吏部尚書，吏部郎中劉從一為刑部侍郎，京兆府戶曹參軍、翰林學士姜公輔為諫議大夫：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the minister of revenue Xiao Fu was made minister of the civil service; the bureau director Liu Congyi was made vice minister of justice; the capital household section staff member and Hanlin academician Jiang Gongfu was made remonstrance official: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Xiao Fu was transferred from revenue to civil service; Liu Congyi became vice minister of justice; and Jiang Gongfu, capital household staff member and Hanlin academician, was appointed remonstrance official—all as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 朱泚犯奉天，禁軍敗績于城東。

translations.literal: Zhu Ci invaded Fengtian; the imperial guard was defeated east of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Ci attacked Fengtian; the imperial guard was routed east of the city.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，靈鹽節度留後杜希全、鄜坊節度使李建徽及朱泚戰于漠谷，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the Ling-Salt acting commissioner Du Xiquan, the Bin-Fang military commissioner Li Jianhui, and Zhu Ci fought at Mogu valley and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Du Xiquan of Ling-Salt and Li Jianhui of Bin-Fang fought Zhu Ci at Mogu and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，劉德信及泚戰于思子陵，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai Liu Dexin and Ci fought at Siziling and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Liu Dexin defeated Zhu Ci at Siziling.

sentences.zh: 甲子，行在都虞候渾瑊及泚戰于城下，敗之，左龍武軍大將軍呂希倩死之。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the traveling-court chief aide Hun Jian and Ci fought below the city and defeated him; the left dragon martial army great general Lü Xiqian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Hun Jian, chief aide of the traveling court, defeated Zhu Ci below the city; Lü Xiqian, great general of the left dragon martial army, was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，將軍高重傑死之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the general Gao Zhongjie died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou General Gao Zhongjie was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，商州軍亂，殺其刺史謝良輔。

translations.literal: That month the Shang prefecture army mutinied and killed its prefect Xie Liangfu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Shang garrison mutinied and killed Prefect Xie Liangfu.

sentences.zh: 十一月，劍南西山兵馬使張朏逐其節度使張延賞，朏伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the Jiannan western hills horse-and-army envoy Zhang Fei drove out his military commissioner Zhang Yanshang; Fei was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang Fei, western Sichuan horse-and-army envoy, expelled commissioner Zhang Yanshang and was executed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，李懷光及朱泚戰于魯店，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Li Huaiguang and Zhu Ci fought at Ludian and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Huaiguang defeated Zhu Ci at Ludian.

sentences.zh: 懷光為中書令、朔方邠寧同華陝虢河中晉絳慈隰行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: Huaiguang was made secretary of the Secretariat and deputy supreme commander of the Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Tong-Hua, Shan-Guo, Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Long campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaiguang was made secretary of the Secretariat and deputy supreme commander of Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Tong-Hua, Shan-Guo, Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Long forces.

sentences.zh: 十二月，朱泚陷華州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhu Ci took Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhu Ci captured Hua.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，貶盧𣏌為新州司馬。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Lu Qi was demoted to aide of Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Lu Qi was demoted to aide of Xin.

sentences.zh: 庚午，李希烈陷汴、鄭二州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu Li Xilie took Bian and Zheng prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Xilie captured Bian and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 興元元年正月癸酉，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Xingyuan on the day guiyou there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xingyuan 1, on guiyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 去「聖神文武」號。

translations.literal: The title Sagely Divine Civil and Martial was removed.
translations.idiomatic: The honorific Sagely Divine Civil and Martial was dropped.

sentences.zh: 復李希烈、田悅、王武俊、李納官爵。

translations.literal: The offices and titles of Li Xilie, Tian Yue, Wang Wujun, and Li Na were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xilie, Tian Yue, Wang Wujun, and Li Na had their offices and titles restored.

sentences.zh: 赴奉天收京城將士有罪減三等，子孫減二等，在行營者賜勳五轉。

translations.literal: For officers and soldiers who went to Fengtian to recover the capital, crimes were reduced three degrees, descendants two degrees; those in the campaign received five merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: Crimes of troops who marched to Fengtian to recover the capital were reduced three degrees, and their descendants two; men in the campaign received five merit rotations.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit records, and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials received ranks, merit records, and titles.

sentences.zh: 罷間架、竹木茶漆稅及除陌錢。

translations.literal: Tax on inter-column space, bamboo, timber, tea, lacquer, and removal of exchange-fee money were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes on floor space, bamboo, timber, tea, lacquer, and exchange fees were abolished.

sentences.zh: 給復奉天五年，城中十年。

translations.literal: Tax relief was granted to Fengtian for five years and to the city for ten.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian received five years' tax relief and the city ten.

sentences.zh: 關播罷。

translations.literal: Guan Bo was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bo was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吏部侍郎盧翰為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu the vice minister of the civil service Lu Han was made vice minister of war and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Lu Han, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed vice minister of war and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蕭復為山南東西、荊湖、淮南、江西、鄂岳、浙江東西、福建、嶺南宣慰安撫使。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Xiao Fu was made pacification and comfort commissioner of Shannan East and West, Jing-Hu, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Zhejiang East and West, Fujian, and Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xiao Fu was made pacification commissioner for Shannan, Jing-Hu, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, the two Zhejiangs, Fujian, and Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，劉洽為汴滑宋亳都統副使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Liu Qia was made deputy overall commander of Bian, Hua, Song, and Bo.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Liu Qia was appointed deputy overall commander of Bian, Hua, Song, and Bo.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，李懷光為太尉，懷光反。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiazi Li Huaiguang was made grand mentor; Huaiguang rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiazi Li Huaiguang was made grand mentor—and then rebelled.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，如梁州。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao he went to Liang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor moved to Liang.

sentences.zh: 懷光將孟庭保以兵來追，左衞大將軍侯仲莊敗之于驛店。

translations.literal: Huaiguang's general Meng Tingbao came in pursuit with troops; the left guard great general Hou Zhongzhuang defeated him at the post station.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huaiguang's general Meng Tingbao pursued with troops; Hou Zhongzhuang of the left guard defeated him at a post station.

sentences.zh: 三月，李懷光奪鄜坊京畿金商節度使李建徽、神策軍兵馬使陽惠元兵，惠元死之。

translations.literal: In the third month Li Huaiguang seized the troops of the Bin-Fang metropolitan circuit and Golden Crow campaign military commissioner Li Jianhui and the Shence army horse-and-army envoy Yang Huiyuan; Huiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Huaiguang seized the armies of Li Jianhui, metropolitan commissioner of Bin-Fang and the capital circuits, and Yang Huiyuan of the Shence campaign; Huiyuan was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，魏博兵馬使田緒殺其節度使田悅，自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the Weibo horse-and-army envoy Tian Xu killed his military commissioner Tian Yue and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Tian Xu, Weibo horse-and-army envoy, killed commissioner Tian Yue and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李懷光殺左廂兵馬使張名振、右武鋒兵馬使石演芬。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Li Huaiguang killed the left wing horse-and-army envoy Zhang Mingzhen and the right martial vanguard horse-and-army envoy Shi Yanfen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Huaiguang executed Zhang Mingzhen, left-wing horse-and-army envoy, and Shi Yanfen, right martial vanguard envoy.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李晟為京畿、渭北、鄜坊丹延節度招討使，神策行營兵馬使尚可孤為神策、京畿、渭南、商州節度招討使。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Li Sheng was made commander to recruit troops of the metropolitan circuits, Weibei, and Bin-Fang, Dan, and Yan; the Shence campaign horse-and-army envoy Shang Ke'gu was made commander to recruit troops of Shence, the metropolitan circuits, Weinan, and Shang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Sheng was made commander of metropolitan, Weibei, and Bin-Fang-Dan-Yan forces; Shang Ke'gu of the Shence campaign was made commander of Shence, metropolitan, Weinan, and Shang forces.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，次梁州。

translations.literal: On the day renchen he halted at Liang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court halted at Liang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，劉洽權知汴滑宋亳都統兵馬事。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Liu Qia was temporarily in charge of Bian, Hua, Song, and Bo campaign horse-and-army affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Liu Qia was given temporary command of Bian, Hua, Song, and Bo campaign forces.

sentences.zh: 己亥，渾瑊為朔方、邠寧、振武、永平、奉天行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Hun Jian was made deputy supreme commander of Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Zhenwu, Yongping, and Fengtian campaign horse-and-army.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Hun Jian was made deputy supreme commander of Shuofang, Bin-Ning, Zhenwu, Yongping, and Fengtian campaign armies.

sentences.zh: 四月，李懷光陷坊州。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Li Huaiguang took Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Li Huaiguang captured Fang.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，李晟為京畿、渭北、商華兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Li Sheng was made deputy supreme commander of metropolitan, Weibei, and Shang-Hua horse-and-army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Li Sheng was made deputy supreme commander of metropolitan, Weibei, and Shang-Hua forces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，姜公輔罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Jiang Gongfu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jiang Gongfu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 涇原兵馬使田希鑒殺其節度使馮河清，自稱留後。

translations.literal: The Jingyuan horse-and-army envoy Tian Xijian killed his military commissioner Feng Heqing and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Xijian, Jingyuan horse-and-army envoy, killed commissioner Feng Heqing and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，渾瑊及朱泚戰于武亭川，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Hun Jian and Zhu Ci fought at Wuting river and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Hun Jian defeated Zhu Ci at Wuting River.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，義王玼薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Prince of Yi Ci died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince of Yi Ci died.

sentences.zh: 是月，坊州刺史竇覦克坊州。

translations.literal: That month the Fang prefecture inspector Dou Guan took Fang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Inspector Dou Guan of Fang recovered the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，涇王侹薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day guiyou Prince of Jing Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on guiyou Prince of Jing Yan died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，李抱真、王武俊及朱滔戰于經城，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi Li Baozhen, Wang Wujun, and Zhu Tao fought at Jingcheng and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Li Baozhen and Wang Wujun defeated Zhu Tao at Jingcheng.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，尚可孤及朱泚戰于藍田之西，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen Shang Ke'gu and Zhu Ci fought west of Lantian and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Shang Ke'gu defeated Zhu Ci west of Lantian.

sentences.zh: 乙未，李晟又敗之于苑北。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei Li Sheng again defeated him north of the park.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Sheng defeated him again north of the park.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，又敗之于白華，復京師。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu he again defeated him at Baihua and recovered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Sheng routed him at Baihua and recovered the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，姚令言伏誅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guimao Yao Lingyan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guimao Yao Lingyan was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，朱泚伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Zhu Ci was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhu Ci was executed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，李晟為司徒、中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Li Sheng was made grand mentor and secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Sheng was appointed grand mentor and secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以梁州為興元府，給復一年，耆老加版授。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Liang prefecture was made Xingyuan prefecture; tax relief for one year; elders received honorary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Liang was renamed Xingyuan prefecture, granted one year's tax relief, and elders received honorary office.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，渾瑊為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin Hun Jian was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Hun Jian was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 己巳，給復洋州一年，加給興元一年，免鳳州今歲稅，父老加版授。

translations.literal: On the day jisi tax relief was granted to Yang prefecture for one year; Xingyuan received an additional year; Feng prefecture's tax for this year was remitted; elders received honorary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Yang received one year's tax relief, Xingyuan an extra year, and Feng's current tax was remitted; elders received honorary office.

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，次鳳翔，免今歲秋稅，八十以上版授刺史，餘授上佐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day bingzi he halted at Fengxiang; this year's autumn tax was remitted; those eighty and above received honorary appointment as prefect, the rest as senior aides.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingzi the court halted at Fengxiang, remitted the autumn tax, granted honorary prefect rank to men over eighty, and senior aide rank to the rest.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，葬宗室遇害者。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou victims among the imperial clan were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou slain members of the imperial clan were buried.

sentences.zh: 壬午，至自興元。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he returned from Xingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the emperor returned from Xingyuan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李懷光殺宣慰使孔巢父。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Li Huaiguang killed the pacification envoy Kong Chaofu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Huaiguang executed pacification envoy Kong Chaofu.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜百官將士階、勳、爵，收京城者升八資。

translations.literal: Officials, generals, and soldiers were granted ranks, merit records, and titles; those who recovered the capital were raised eight salary grades.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and troops received ranks, merit records, and titles; men who recovered the capital were raised eight salary grades.

sentences.zh: 給復京兆府一年。

translations.literal: Tax relief was granted to the metropolitan prefecture for one year.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan prefecture received one year's tax relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，嗣曹王皐及李希烈戰于應山，敗之。

translations.literal: That month the Prince of Cao Gao and Li Xilie fought at Yingshan and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Cao Gao defeated Li Xilie at Yingshan.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，李晟為鳳翔隴右諸軍、涇原四鎮北庭行營兵馬副元帥，馬燧為晉、慈、隰諸軍行營兵馬副元帥，渾瑊為河中、同絳、陝虢諸軍行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guimao Li Sheng was made deputy supreme commander of Fengxiang, Longyou, Jingyuan Four Garrisons, and Northern Frontier campaign horse-and-army; Ma Sui was made deputy supreme commander of the Jin, Ci, and Long campaign; Hun Jian was made deputy supreme commander of the Hezhong, Tong, Jiang, and Shan-Guo campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guimao Li Sheng was made deputy commander of Fengxiang-Longyou and the Jingyuan-Northern Frontier campaign; Ma Sui of Jin-Ci-Long; and Hun Jian of Hezhong-Tong-Jiang-Shan-Guo.

sentences.zh: 丙午，渾瑊兼朔方行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Hun Jian was additionally made deputy supreme commander of the Shuofang campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hun Jian was also made deputy commander of the Shuofang campaign.

sentences.zh: 己酉，延王玢、隋王迅薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Prince of Yan Bing and Prince of Sui Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Princes of Yan Bing and Sui Xun died.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑，李勉檢校司徒、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinchou Li Mian was made acting grand mentor and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinchou Li Mian was appointed acting grand mentor and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，李希烈將李澄以滑州降。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day wuzi Li Xilie's general Li Cheng surrendered with Hua prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on wuzi Li Cheng, a general of Li Xilie, surrendered Hua.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，劉洽、邠隴行營節度使曲環及李希烈戰于陳州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guimao Liu Qia, the Bin-Long campaign military commissioner Qu Huan, and Li Xilie fought at Chen prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guimao Liu Qia and Qu Huan of Bin-Long defeated Li Xilie at Chen.

sentences.zh: 戊午，克汴州。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu Bian prefecture was taken.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Bian was recovered.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，蕭復罷。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Xiao Fu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Xiao Fu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，渾瑊及李懷光戰于乾坑，敗績。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yiyou Hun Jian and Li Huaiguang fought at Qiankeng and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yiyou Hun Jian fought Li Huaiguang at Qiankeng and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 是歲，陳王珪薨。

translations.literal: That year Prince of Chen Gui died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince of Chen Gui died.

sentences.zh: 貞元元年正月丁酉，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Zhenyuan on the day dingyou there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhenyuan 1, on dingyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 罷榷稅。

translations.literal: Monopoly taxes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Monopoly taxes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月，李懷光殺步軍兵馬使田仙浩、都虞候呂鳴岳。

translations.literal: In the third month Li Huaiguang killed the infantry horse-and-army envoy Tian Xianhao and chief aide Lü Mingyue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Li Huaiguang killed Tian Xianhao, infantry horse-and-army envoy, and Lü Mingyue, chief aide.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李希烈陷鄧州，殺唐鄧隋招討使黃金岳。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Li Xilie took Deng prefecture and killed the Tang-Deng-Sui commander Huang Jinyue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Li Xilie captured Deng and killed Huang Jinyue, commander of Tang-Deng-Sui.

sentences.zh: 是春，旱。

translations.literal: That spring there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: That spring drought struck.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，徙封誼為舒王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yichou the fief of Yi was moved to Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yichou Yi was transferred to Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，渾瑊及李懷光戰于長春宮，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day renwu Hun Jian and Li Huaiguang fought at Changchun palace and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Hun Jian defeated Li Huaiguang at Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，馬燧、渾瑊為河中招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Ma Sui and Hun Jian were made commanders to pacify Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ma Sui and Hun Jian were appointed to pacify Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 六月己丑，幽州盧龍軍節度使朱滔卒，涿州刺史劉怦自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jichou the Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Zhu Tao died; the Zhuo prefecture inspector Liu Zheng styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jichou Zhu Tao of Lulong died; Liu Zheng of Zhuo declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，劍南西川節度使張延賞為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Zhang Yanshang was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhang Yanshang of western Sichuan was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，馬燧及李懷光戰于陶城，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Ma Sui and Li Huaiguang fought at Taocheng and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Ma Sui defeated Li Huaiguang at Taocheng.

sentences.zh: 七月，灞、滻竭。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Ba and Chan rivers dried up.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Ba and Chan rivers ran dry.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a violent wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 八月，襲封配饗功臣子孫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month descendants of meritorious ministers with collateral sacrifice were enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month descendants of meritorious ministers with collateral temple shares were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi because of drought he avoided the main hall and reduced meals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, because of drought, he avoided the main hall and reduced his meals.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李懷光伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Li Huaiguang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Huaiguang was executed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，給復河中、同絳二州一年。

translations.literal: On the day jimao tax relief was granted to Hezhong and Tong-Jiang for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Hezhong and Tong-Jiang received one year's tax relief.

sentences.zh: 馬燧為侍中，張延賞罷。

translations.literal: Ma Sui was made palace attendant; Zhang Yanshang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui was appointed palace attendant; Zhang Yanshang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，李希烈殺宣慰使顏真卿。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Li Xilie killed the pacification envoy Yan Zhenqing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Xilie executed pacification envoy Yan Zhenqing.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，劉從一罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day xinhai Liu Congyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinhai Liu Congyi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幽州盧龍軍節度使劉怦卒，其子濟自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Liu Zheng died; his son Ji styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Liu Zheng of Lulong died; his son Ji declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是秋，雨木冰。

translations.literal: That autumn rain froze on trees.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn glaze ice formed on trees.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，有事于南郊，大赦，賜奉天興元扈從百官、收京將士階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guimao the southern suburban rite was performed; there was a great amnesty; ranks, merit records, and titles were granted to officials who followed to Fengtian and Xingyuan and troops who recovered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guimao the southern suburban rite was performed and a general amnesty proclaimed; ranks, merit, and titles were granted to officials and troops of the Fengtian-Xingyuan and capital-recovery campaigns.

sentences.zh: 二年正月丙申，詔減御膳之半，賙貧乏者授以官。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year on the day bingshen it was decreed that imperial meals be halved and the poor be given office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on bingshen, the court halved imperial meals and granted office to the destitute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，盧翰罷。

translations.literal: On the day renyin Lu Han was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Lu Han was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎劉滋為左散騎常侍，給事中崔造，中書舍人齊映：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The vice minister of the civil service Liu Zi was made left cavalier attendant-in-ordinary; the supervising secretary Cui Zao and the secretariat drafting officer Qi Ying: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zi, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed left cavalier attendant-in-ordinary; Cui Zao, supervising secretary; and Qi Ying, drafting officer—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，山南東道節度使樊澤及李希烈戰于泌河，敗之。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guihai the Shannan East circuit military commissioner Fan Ze and Li Xilie fought at the Mi river and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guihai Fan Ze of Shannan East defeated Li Xilie at the Mi River.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，希烈伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingyin Xilie was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingyin Li Xilie was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu dust fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，給復淮西二年。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen tax relief was granted to Huai West for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Huai West received two years' tax relief.

sentences.zh: 五月，李希烈將李惠登以隋州降。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Li Xilie's general Li Huideng surrendered with Sui prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Li Huideng, a general of Li Xilie, surrendered Sui.

sentences.zh: 己酉，地震。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，滄州刺史程日華卒，其子懷直自稱觀察留後。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guiwei the Cang prefecture inspector Cheng Rihua died; his son Huaizhi styled himself acting observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guiwei Cheng Rihua of Cang died; his son Huaizhi declared himself acting observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，淮西兵馬使吳少誠殺其節度使陳仙奇，自稱留後。

translations.literal: That month the Huai West horse-and-army envoy Wu Shaoqing killed his military commissioner Chen Xianqi and styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wu Shaoqing, Huai West horse-and-army envoy, killed commissioner Chen Xianqi and declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，李希烈將薛翼以唐州降，侯召以光州降。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Li Xilie's general Xue Yi surrendered with Tang prefecture; Hou Zhao surrendered with Guang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xue Yi, a general of Li Xilie, surrendered Tang; Hou Zhao surrendered Guang.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingzi great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingzi severe hail fell.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吐蕃寇邠、寧、涇、隴四州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Tibet raided the four prefectures Bin, Ning, Jing, and Long.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Tibet raided Bin, Ning, Jing, and Long.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，寇好畤，李晟敗之于汧陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day yisi they raided Haochi; Li Sheng defeated them at Qianyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yisi Tibet raided Haochi; Li Sheng defeated them at Qianyang.

sentences.zh: 十月癸酉，邠寧節度使韓游瓌又敗之于平川。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day guiyou the Bin-Ning military commissioner Han Yougui again defeated them at Pingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guiyou Han Yougui of Bin-Ning defeated them again at Pingchuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，立淑妃王氏為皇后。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiawu the worthy consort of the Shu clan was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiawu Worthy Consort Wang was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇后崩。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou the empress died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the empress died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，吐蕃陷鹽州。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Tibet took Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Tibet captured Yan.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，陷夏州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingsi they took Xia prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingsi Tibet captured Xia.

sentences.zh: 馬燧為綏、銀、麟、勝招討使。

translations.literal: Ma Sui was made commander to recruit troops of Sui, Yin, Lin, and Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Sui was appointed commander against Sui, Yin, Lin, and Sheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，崔造罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Cui Zao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Cui Zao was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以吐蕃寇邊，避正殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu because Tibet raided the frontier he avoided the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, because of Tibetan raids, he avoided the main hall.

sentences.zh: 三年正月壬寅，尚書左僕射張延賞同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day renyin the left vice director of the Department of State Affairs Zhang Yanshang was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on renyin, Zhang Yanshang, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬子，劉滋罷。

translations.literal: On the day renzi Liu Zi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Liu Zi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 貶齊映為夔州刺史。

translations.literal: Qi Ying was demoted to prefect of Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Ying was demoted to prefect of Kui.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎柳渾同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The vice minister of war Liu Hun was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hun, vice minister of war, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，華州潼關節度使駱元光克鹽、夏二州。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jimao the Hua-Tongguan military commissioner Luo Yuanguang took Yan and Xia prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jimao Luo Yuanguang of Hua-Tongguan recovered Yan and Xia.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬昭德皇后于靖陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Empress Zhaode was buried at Jing tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Empress Zhaode was buried at Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，李晟為太尉。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingwei Li Sheng was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei Li Sheng was appointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，馬燧罷副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Ma Sui was dismissed as deputy supreme commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Ma Sui was relieved as deputy supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 五月，揚州江溢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Yangzhou river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Yangzhou river burst its banks.

sentences.zh: 吳少誠殺申州刺史張伯元、殿中侍御史鄭常。

translations.literal: Wu Shaoqing killed the Shen prefecture inspector Zhang Boyuan and the palace aide censor Zheng Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shaoqing killed Zhang Boyuan, inspector of Shen, and palace aide censor Zheng Chang.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛未，渾瑊及吐蕃盟于平涼，吐蕃執會盟副使、兵部尚書崔漢衡，殺判官、殿中侍御史韓弇。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day xinwei Hun Jian and Tibet allied at Pingliang; Tibet seized the alliance deputy envoy, the minister of war Cui Hanheng, and killed the judge, the palace aide censor Han Yan.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on xinwei Hun Jian allied with Tibet at Pingliang; Tibet seized deputy envoy Cui Hanheng, minister of war, and killed judge Han Yan, palace aide censor.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 六月，吐蕃寇鹽、夏二州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Tibet raided Yan and Xia prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Tibet raided Yan and Xia.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，馬燧為司徙，前陝虢觀察使李泌為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Ma Sui was made minister of works; the former Shan-Guo observation commissioner Li Bi was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Ma Sui was appointed minister of works; Li Bi, former Shan-Guo observer, was made vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，朔方節度使杜希全為朔方、靈鹽、豐夏綏銀節度都統。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi the Shuofang military commissioner Du Xiquan was made overall military commissioner of Shuofang, Ling-Salt, Feng-Xia, and Sui-Yin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi Du Xiquan of Shuofang was made overall commissioner of Shuofang, Ling-Salt, Feng-Xia, and Sui-Yin.

sentences.zh: 壬申，張延賞薨。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Zhang Yanshang died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhang Yanshang died.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the first day of the month xinsi there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己丑，柳渾罷。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Liu Hun was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Liu Hun was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊申，吐蕃寇青石嶺，隴州刺史蘇清沔敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Tibet raided Qingstone ridge; the Long prefecture inspector Su Qingqian defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Tibet raided Qingstone Ridge; Su Qingqian of Long defeated them.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，禁大馬出蒲、潼、武關。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu large horses were forbidden to pass out of Pu, Tong, and Wu passes.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu large horses were forbidden to pass Pu, Tong, and Wu passes.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，吐蕃寇汧陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dingsi Tibet raided Qianyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingsi Tibet raided Qianyang.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，陷華亭及連雲堡。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin they took Huating and Lianyun fortress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Tibet captured Huating and Lianyun Fortress.

sentences.zh: 十月甲申，寇豐義，韓游瓌敗之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiashen they raided Fengyi; Han Yougui defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiashen Tibet raided Fengyi; Han Yougui defeated them.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，寇長武城，城使韓全義敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou they raided Changwu city; the city envoy Han Quanyi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Tibet raided Changwu; city envoy Han Quanyi defeated them.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，射生將韓欽緒謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renchen the archer Han Qinxu plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen archer Han Qinxu plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，京師、東都、河中地震。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jimao the capital, eastern capital, and Hezhong earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jimao the capital, Luoyang, and Hezhong were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚辰，獵于新店。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengchen he hunted at Xindian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengchen the emperor hunted at Xindian.

sentences.zh: 四年正月庚戌朔，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year on the first day of the month gengxu the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the fourth year, gengxu, the capital was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 大赦，刺史予一子官，增戶墾田者加階，縣令減選，九品以上官言事。

translations.literal: There was a great amnesty; prefects' sons received office; those who increased households and opened fields received higher rank; magistrates' selection was reduced; officials of the ninth rank and above might speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed: prefects' sons received office; those who increased households and reclaimed land received higher rank; magistrates faced reduced selection scrutiny; and officials of the ninth rank or above could submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬申，劉玄佐為四鎮北庭行營、涇原節度副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Liu Xuanzuo was made deputy supreme commander of the Four Garrisons Northern Frontier campaign and Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Liu Xuanzuo was made deputy commander of the Four Garrisons-Northern Frontier and Jingyuan campaigns.

sentences.zh: 是月，金、房二州地震，江溢山裂。

translations.literal: That month Jin and Fang prefectures earthquake; rivers overflowed and mountains split.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin and Fang were shaken; rivers flooded and hills split.

sentences.zh: 雨木冰于陳留。

translations.literal: Rain froze on trees at Chenliu.
translations.idiomatic: Glaze ice formed on trees at Chenliu.

sentences.zh: 四月，河南、淮海地生毛。
