translations.literal: In the fourth month in Henan and Huaihai regions hair grew from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month hair sprouted from the soil in Henan and along the Huai.

sentences.zh: 己亥，福建軍亂，逐其觀察使吳詵，大將郝誡溢自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the Fujian army mutinied and drove out its observation commissioner Wu Shen; the great general Hao Jieyi styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Fujian garrison mutinied, expelled observer Wu Shen, and Hao Jieyi declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五月，吐蕃寇涇、邠、寧、慶、鄜五州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Tibet raided the five prefectures Jing, Bin, Ning, Qing, and Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Tibet raided Jing, Bin, Ning, Qing, and Zheng.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，封子謜為邕王。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jihai the son Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jihai his son Yan was enfeoffed Prince of Yong.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，渾瑊為邠、寧、慶副元帥。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengxu Hun Jian was made deputy supreme commander of Bin, Ning, and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengxu Hun Jian was made deputy commander of Bin, Ning, and Qing.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，寧州軍亂，邠寧都虞候楊朝晟敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou the Ning prefecture army mutinied; the Bin-Ning chief aide Yang Chaosheng defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Ning garrison mutinied; Yang Chaosheng of Bin-Ning suppressed it.

sentences.zh: 己未，奚、室韋寇振武。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei the Xi and Shiwei raided Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Xi and Shiwei raided Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 是月，河水黑。

translations.literal: That month the river water turned black.
translations.idiomatic: That month the river ran black.

sentences.zh: 八月，灞水溢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Ba river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Ba River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，吐蕃寇寧州，邠寧節度使張獻甫敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengshen Tibet raided Ning prefecture; the Bin-Ning military commissioner Zhang Xianfu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengshen Tibet raided Ning; Zhang Xianfu of Bin-Ning defeated them.

sentences.zh: 冬，築夾城。

translations.literal: In winter walled cities were built.
translations.idiomatic: In winter the court built walled encampments.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師地震二十。

translations.literal: That year the capital earthquake twenty times.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital was shaken by twenty earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 五年正月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year on the first day of the month jiachen there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's Day of the fifth year, jiachen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，大理卿董晉為門下侍郎，御史大夫竇參為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day gengzi the grand justice Dong Jin was made vice director of the Chancellery and the censor-in-chief Dou Can vice secretary of the Secretariat: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on gengzi Dong Jin, grand justice, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery, and Dou Can, censor-in-chief, vice secretary—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，李泌薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiachen Li Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiachen Li Bi died.

sentences.zh: 夏，吐蕃寇長武城，韓全義敗之于佛堂原。

translations.literal: In summer Tibet raided Changwu city; Han Quanyi defeated them at Fotang plain.
translations.idiomatic: In summer Tibet raided Changwu; Han Quanyi defeated them at Fotang Plain.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，劍南西川節度使韋皐敗吐蕃于臺登北谷，克巂州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingwu the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Wei Gao defeated Tibet north of Taideng valley and took Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingwu Wei Gao of western Sichuan defeated Tibet north of Taideng and recovered Yan.

sentences.zh: 十月，嶺南節度使李復克瓊州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Lingnan military commissioner Li Fu took Qiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Fu of Lingnan recovered Qiong.

sentences.zh: 六年春，旱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year spring there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year drought struck.

sentences.zh: 閏四月乙卯，詔常參官、畿縣令言事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month on the day yimao it was decreed that regular-attendance officials and metropolitan county magistrates speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month on yimao the court ordered regular-attendance officials and metropolitan magistrates to submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 免京兆府夏稅。

translations.literal: The metropolitan prefecture's summer tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: The metropolitan prefecture's summer tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，殺皇太子妃蕭氏。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinchou the heir apparent's consort of the Xiao clan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinchou the crown prince's consort, née Xiao, was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wuchen offering was made at the Supreme Clear palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuchen the emperor offered at the Supreme Clear Palace.

sentences.zh: 己巳，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚午，有事于南郊。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu the southern suburban rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he performed the southern suburban rite.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials received ranks and titles.

sentences.zh: 降囚罪，徒以下原之。

translations.literal: Prisoners' crimes were reduced; those below exile were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Sentences were reduced; those below exile were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 葬戰亡暴骨者。

translations.literal: Those who died in battle with exposed bones were buried.
translations.idiomatic: The dead from battle whose bones lay exposed were buried.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐蕃陷北庭都護府，節度使楊襲古奔于西州。

translations.literal: That year Tibet took the Beiting protectorate; the military commissioner Yang Xigu fled to Xi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tibet seized Beiting; commissioner Yang Xigu fled to Xi.

sentences.zh: 七年正月己巳，襄王僙薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year in the first month on the day jisi Prince of Xiang Qian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, on jisi, Prince of Xiang Qian died.

sentences.zh: 四月，安南首領杜英翰反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Annan leader Du Yinghan rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Du Yinghan, Annan leader, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申，端王遇薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jiashen Prince of Duan Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiashen Prince of Duan Yu died.

sentences.zh: 九月，回鶻殺楊襲古。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Uyghurs killed Yang Xigu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Uyghurs killed Yang Xigu.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，睦王述薨。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year in the first month on the day yisi the Yiding army and Wu Shaoqing fought and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixteenth year, on yisi, Yiding forces fought Wu Shaoqing and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 二月乙酉，鹽夏綏銀節度使韓全義為蔡州行營招討處置使，上官涗副之。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yiyou the Yan-Xia-Sui-Yin military commissioner Han Quanyi was made commander to recruit and dispose troops of the Cai prefecture campaign; Shangguan Suo was deputy.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yiyou Han Quanyi of Yan-Xia-Sui-Yin was made commander of the Cai campaign; Shangguan Suo was deputy.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，黔中宴設將傅近逐其觀察使吳士宗。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dinghai the Qianzhong banquet-setup general Fu Jin drove out its observation commissioner Wu Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dinghai Fu Jin of Qianzhong expelled observer Wu Shizong.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，韓全義及吳少誠戰于廣利城，敗績。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengxu Han Quanyi and Wu Shaoqing fought at Guangli city and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengxu Han Quanyi fought Wu Shaoqing at Guangli and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 壬子，徐泗濠節度使張建封卒，其子愔自稱知軍事。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the Xu-Si-Hao military commissioner Zhang Jianfeng died; his son Yin styled himself in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Zhang Jianfeng of Xu-Si-Hao died; his son Yin took charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳，伊慎及吳少誠戰于申州，敗之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dingsi Yi Shen and Wu Shaoqing fought at Shen prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingsi Yi Shen defeated Wu Shaoqing at Shen.

sentences.zh: 己未，韋皐克吐蕃末恭城。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei Wei Gao took the Tibetan Mogong city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Wei Gao captured the Tibetan stronghold Mogong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，韓全義及吳少誠戰于五樓，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin Han Quanyi and Wu Shaoqing fought at Wulou and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Han Quanyi fought Wu Shaoqing at Wulou and was defeated again.

sentences.zh: 八月，劉濟及其弟涿州刺史源戰于涿州，源敗，執之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liu Ji and his younger brother the Zhuo prefecture inspector Yuan fought at Zhuo prefecture; Yuan was defeated and captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Ji fought his brother Yuan, inspector of Zhuo; Yuan was defeated and captured.

sentences.zh: 己丑，殺遂州別駕崔位。

translations.literal: On the day jichou the Sui prefecture vice prefect Cui Wei was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cui Wei, vice prefect of Sui, was executed.

sentences.zh: 韋皐克吐蕃顒城。

translations.literal: Wei Gao took the Tibetan Yong city.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Gao captured the Tibetan stronghold Yong.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，貶鄭餘慶為郴州司馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengxu Zheng Yuqing was demoted to aide of Chen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengxu Zheng Yuqing was demoted to aide of Chen.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太常卿齊抗為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen the minister of sacrifices Qi Kang was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Qi Kang, minister of sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月辛未，殺通州別駕崔河圖。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinwei the Tong prefecture vice prefect Cui Hetu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinwei Cui Hetu, vice prefect of Tong, was executed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京師饑。

translations.literal: That year the capital had famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月丁酉，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year in the second month on the day dingyou great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventeenth year, on dingyou, severe hail fell.

sentences.zh: 己亥，霜。

translations.literal: On the day jihai there was frost.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai frost appeared.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，韋皐及吐蕃戰于鹿危山，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Wei Gao and Tibet fought at Luwei mountain and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wei Gao defeated Tibet at Luwei Mountain.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大雨雹，震電。

translations.literal: On the day wushen great hail fell with thunder and lightning.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen violent hail fell amid thunder and lightning.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大雪，雨雹。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu great snow; hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu heavy snow fell, then hail.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the first day of the month renxu there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, renxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，寧州軍亂，殺其刺史劉南金。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingshen the Ning prefecture army mutinied and killed its prefect Liu Nanjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingshen the Ning garrison mutinied and killed Prefect Liu Nanjin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，浙西觀察使李錡殺上封事人崔善貞。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the Zhexi observation commissioner Li Qi killed the memorial submitter Cui Shanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Qi of Zhexi killed memorial submitter Cui Shanzhen.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，成德軍節度使王武俊卒，其子士真自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi the Chengde army military commissioner Wang Wujun died; his son Shizhen styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wang Wujun of Chengde died; his son Shizhen declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月，隕霜殺菽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month frost killed beans.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month late frost destroyed the bean crop.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，吐蕃寇鹽州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin Tibet raided Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Tibet raided Yan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，陷麟州，刺史郭鋒死之。

translations.literal: On the day jichou they took Lin prefecture; the prefect Guo Feng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Tibet captured Lin; Prefect Guo Feng was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，韋皐敗吐蕃于雅州，克木波城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day yihai Wei Gao defeated Tibet at Ya prefecture and took Mubo city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yihai Wei Gao defeated Tibet at Ya and took Mubo.

sentences.zh: 是歲，嘉王運薨。

translations.literal: That year Prince of Jia Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince of Jia Yun died.

sentences.zh: 十八年七月乙亥，罷正衙奏事。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year in the seventh month on the day yihai regular memorials at the main court were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighteenth year, on yihai, regular memorials at the main court were ended.

sentences.zh: 十二月，環王陷驩、愛二州。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the king of Huan took Huan and Ai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the king of Huan seized Huan and Ai.

sentences.zh: 十九年二月己亥，安南將王季元逐其經略使裴泰，兵馬使趙均敗之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year in the second month on the day jihai the Annan general Wang Jiyuan drove out its frontier commissioner Pei Tai; the horse-and-army envoy Zhao Jun defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the nineteenth year, on jihai, Wang Jiyuan of Annan expelled frontier commissioner Pei Tai; Zhao Jun defeated him.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，淮南節度使杜佑檢校司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day renzi the Huainan military commissioner Du You was made acting minister of works and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on renzi Du You of Huainan was appointed acting minister of works and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月己未，齊抗罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiwei Qi Kang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiwei Qi Kang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 自正月不雨至于是月。

translations.literal: From the first month no rain until this month.
translations.idiomatic: From the first month until this month no rain had fallen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 閏十月庚戌，鹽州將李庭俊反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month on the day gengxu the Yan prefecture general Li Tingjun rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month on gengxu Li Tingjun of Yan rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，崔損薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi Cui Sun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Cui Sun died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，太常卿高郢為中書侍郎，吏部侍郎鄭珣瑜為門下侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengshen the minister of sacrifices Gao Ying was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; the vice minister of the civil service Zheng Qiongyu was made vice director of the Chancellery: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengshen Gao Ying, minister of sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary; Zheng Qiongyu, vice minister of the civil service, vice director of the Chancellery—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二十年二月庚戌，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year in the second month on the day gengxu great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twentieth year, on gengxu, severe hail fell.

sentences.zh: 七月癸酉，大雨雹。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day guiyou great hail fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guiyou severe hail fell again.

sentences.zh: 冬，雨木冰。

translations.literal: In winter rain froze on trees.
translations.idiomatic: In winter glaze ice formed on trees.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月癸巳，皇帝崩于會寧殿，年六十四。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year in the first month on the day guisi the emperor died at the Huining hall, age sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year, on guisi, the emperor died at Huining Hall, aged sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 順宗順宗至德弘道大聖大安孝皇帝諱誦，德宗長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Shunzong, Emperor Shunzong the Supreme Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial, taboo name Song, was the eldest son of Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shunzong, posthumously honored as the Supreme Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial, bore the taboo name Song and was the eldest son of Dezong.

sentences.zh: 母曰昭德皇后王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuangxian of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuangxian, née Wang.

sentences.zh: 始封宣城郡王，大曆十四年六月，進封宣王。

translations.literal: He was first enfeoffed Prince of Xuancheng commandery; in the sixth month of the fourteenth year of Dali he was advanced to Prince of Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was first enfeoffed Prince of Xuancheng; in the sixth month of Dali 14 he was promoted to Prince of Xuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yimao he was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yimao he was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 為人寬仁，喜學藝，善隸書，禮重師傅，見輒先拜。

translations.literal: By nature he was generous and benevolent, fond of learning and skilled in clerical script; he honored his teachers heavily and when he saw them would bow first.
translations.idiomatic: He was by nature generous and benevolent, devoted to learning and skilled in clerical script. He greatly honored his tutors and always bowed to them first.

sentences.zh: 從德宗幸奉天，常執弓矢居左右。

translations.literal: When he followed Dezong to Fengtian he often held bow and arrows and stayed at his side.
translations.idiomatic: When he accompanied Dezong to Fengtian he often stood at his side with bow in hand.

sentences.zh: 郜國公主以蠱事得罪，太子妃，其女也，德宗疑之，幾廢者屢矣，賴李泌保護，乃免。

translations.literal: The Princess of Guo was condemned for sorcery; she was the heir apparent's consort, her daughter; Dezong suspected him and several times nearly deposed him; only through Li Bi's protection was he spared.
translations.idiomatic: When the Princess of Guo was condemned for sorcery—she was his consort's mother—Dezong grew suspicious and several times nearly deposed him; only Li Bi's protection saved him.

sentences.zh: 後侍宴魚藻宮，張水嬉綵艦，宮人為櫂歌，眾樂間發，德宗驩甚，顧太子曰：「今日何如？

translations.literal: Later at a banquet at Yuzao palace colored warships floated on the water for amusement; palace women rowed with songs; many instruments played in turn; Dezong was very pleased and turned to the heir apparent saying: "How is today?"
translations.idiomatic: Later, at a banquet at Yuzao Palace, painted warships floated for water games while palace women rowed and sang amid many instruments. Dezong was delighted and asked the heir apparent, "How does today compare?"

sentences.zh: 」太子誦詩「好樂無荒」以為對。

translations.literal: The heir apparent recited the poem "Delight in music without excess" in reply.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent answered by quoting the line "Delight in music, but do not be reckless."

sentences.zh: 及裴延齡、韋渠牟用事，世皆畏其為相，太子每候顏色，陳其不可。

translations.literal: When Pei Yanling and Wei Qumou held power all the world feared they would become chancellors; the heir apparent each time watched their expressions and stated they were unfit.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Yanling and Wei Qumou held power everyone feared they would reach the chancellorship; the heir apparent repeatedly watched their conduct and argued they were unfit.

sentences.zh: 故二人者卒不得用。

translations.literal: Therefore the two men in the end were not employed.
translations.idiomatic: Thus neither man was ever appointed.

sentences.zh: 貞元二十年，太子病風且瘖。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhenyuan the heir apparent suffered wind affliction and became mute.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 20 the heir apparent suffered a stroke and lost his voice.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，不能朝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year he could not attend court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year he could no longer attend court.

sentences.zh: 是時，德宗不豫，諸王皆侍左右，惟太子臥病，不能見，德宗悲傷涕泣，疾有加。

translations.literal: At that time Dezong was unwell; all the princes attended at his side; only the heir apparent lay ill and could not be seen; Dezong grieved and wept; his illness grew worse.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong was then gravely ill. All the princes waited at his side, but the heir apparent lay too ill to appear. Dezong wept in grief and his condition worsened.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，德宗崩。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Dezong died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Dezong died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，即皇帝位于太極殿。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen he ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，朝羣臣于紫宸門。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guimao he met the ministers at the Purple Impenetrable gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guimao he received the ministers at the Purple Impenetrable Gate.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，吏部侍郎韋執誼為尚書左丞、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the vice minister of the civil service Wei Zhiyi was made left director of the Department of State Affairs and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Wei Zhiyi, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed left director of the Department of State Affairs and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 罷宮市。

translations.literal: The palace market was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The palace market was abolished.

sentences.zh: 民百歲版授下州刺史，婦人郡君；

translations.literal: Commoners one hundred years old received honorary appointment as vice prefect of lower prefectures; women as commandery ladies;
translations.idiomatic: Commoners aged one hundred received honorary vice prefect rank; women, commandery lady rank;

sentences.zh: 九十以上上佐，婦人縣君。

translations.literal: those ninety and above received senior aide, women county lady.
translations.idiomatic: those ninety and above, senior aide; women, county lady.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷鹽鐵使月進。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the salt-iron commissioner's monthly tribute was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the salt-iron commissioner's monthly tribute was ended.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，放後宮三百人。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day gengwu three hundred rear-palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengwu three hundred rear-palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，放後宮及教坊女妓六百人。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou six hundred rear-palace and Pear Garden female performers were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou six hundred rear-palace and Pear Garden performers were released.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，立廣陵郡王純為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day guisi Prince of Guangling commandery Chun was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince of Guangling Chun was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅，封弟諤為欽王，諴珍王；

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day renyin the younger brother E was enfeoffed Prince of Qin, Shen Prince of Zhen;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renyin his younger brothers E and Shen were enfeoffed as Princes of Qin and Zhen;

sentences.zh: 進封子建康郡王經郯王，洋川郡王緯均王，臨淮郡王縱漵王，弘農郡王紓莒王，漢東郡王綱密王，晉陵郡王緫郇王，高平郡王約邵王，雲安郡王結宋王，宣城郡王緗集王，德陽郡王絿冀王，河東郡王綺和王；

translations.literal: the son Prince of Jiankang commandery Jing was advanced to Prince of Tan, Prince of Yangchuan commandery Wei Prince of Jun, Prince of Linhuai commandery Zong Prince of Su, Prince of Hongnong commandery Shu Prince of Ju, Prince of Handong commandery Gang Prince of Mi, Prince of Jinling commandery Zong Prince of Xun, Prince of Gaoping commandery Yue Prince of Shao, Prince of Yun'an commandery Jie Prince of Song, Prince of Xuancheng commandery Xiang Prince of Ji, Prince of Deyang commandery Hui Prince of Ji;
translations.idiomatic: his sons Jing, Wei, Zong, Shu, Gang, Zong, Yue, Jie, Xiang, and Hui were promoted or enfeoffed as Princes of Tan, Jun, Su, Ju, Mi, Xun, Shao, Song, Ji, and Ji respectively;

sentences.zh: 封子絢為衡王，纁會王，綰福王，紘撫王，緄岳王，紳袁王，綸桂王，繟翼王。

translations.literal: the sons Xuan was enfeoffed Prince of Heng, Xu Prince of Hui, Wan Prince of Fu, Hong Prince of Fu, Lun Prince of Yue, Shen Prince of Yuan, Lun Prince of Gui, and Xun Prince of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: and Xuan, Xu, Wan, Hong, Lun, Shen, Lun, and Xun were enfeoffed as Princes of Heng, Hui, Fu, Fu, Yue, Yuan, Gui, and Yi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以冊皇太子，降死罪以下，賜文武官子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: On the day wushen because of installing the heir apparent, death sentences and below were reduced; civil and military officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, marking the heir apparent's installation, death sentences and below were reduced and officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.

sentences.zh: 七月辛卯，橫海軍節度使程懷信卒，其子執恭自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinmao the Henghai army military commissioner Cheng Huaixin died; his son Zhigong styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinmao Cheng Huaixin of Henghai died; his son Zhigong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，皇太子權句當軍國政事。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei the heir apparent temporarily handled state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the heir apparent was given temporary charge of state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 太常卿杜黃裳為門下侍郎，左金吾衞大將軍袁滋為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The minister of sacrifices Du Huangxiang was made vice director of the Chancellery; the left great general of the Golden Crow Guard Yuan Zi was made vice secretary of the Secretariat: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huangxiang, minister of sacrifices, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Yuan Zi, left great general of the Golden Crow Guard, vice secretary—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 鄭珣瑜、高郢罷。

translations.literal: Zheng Qiongyu and Gao Ying were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Qiongyu and Gao Ying were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 永貞元年八月庚子，立皇太子為皇帝，自稱曰太上皇。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzhen in the eighth month on the day gengzi the heir apparent was established as emperor; he styled himself Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yongzhen 1, on gengzi, the heir apparent was enthroned and Shunzong styled himself Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，改元。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 降死罪以下。

translations.literal: Death sentences and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Death sentences and below were reduced.

sentences.zh: 立良娣王氏為太上皇后。

translations.literal: The worthy consort of the Wang clan was established as Retired Empress.
translations.idiomatic: Worthy Consort Wang was honored as Retired Empress.

sentences.zh: 元和元年正月，皇帝率羣臣上尊號曰應乾聖壽太上皇。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanhe the emperor led the ministers to present an honorific title saying Responsive to Heaven, Sagely Longevity Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanhe 1 the new emperor led the court in offering Shunzong the honorific Responsive to Heaven, Sagely Longevity Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 是月，崩于咸寧殿，年四十六，謚曰至德大聖大安孝皇帝。

translations.literal: That month he died at the Xianning hall, age forty-six; the posthumous title was Supreme Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial emperor.
translations.idiomatic: That month he died at Xianning Hall, aged forty-six, with the posthumous title Supreme Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial.

sentences.zh: 大中三年，增謚至德弘道大聖大安孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dazhong the posthumous title was increased to Supreme Virtue, Expansive Way, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong 3 his posthumous title was expanded to Supreme Virtue, Expansive Way, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial.

sentences.zh: 憲宗憲宗昭文章武大聖至神孝皇帝諱純，順宗長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong, Emperor Xianzong the Sagely Civil, Martial, Great Sagely, Supreme Spirit, and Filial, taboo name Chun, was the eldest son of Shunzong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong, posthumously honored as the Sagely Civil, Martial, Great Sagely, Supreme Spirit, and Filial, bore the taboo name Chun and was the eldest son of Shunzong.

sentences.zh: 母曰莊憲皇太后王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuangxian of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Zhuangxian, née Wang.

sentences.zh: 貞元四年六月己亥，封廣陵郡王。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan in the sixth month on the day jihai he was enfeoffed Prince of Guangling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Zhenyuan 4, on jihai, he was enfeoffed Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year he was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year he was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 永貞元年八月，順宗詔立為皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yongzhen Shunzong decreed he be established as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yongzhen 1 Shunzong decreed his enthronement.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，即皇帝位于太極殿。

translations.literal: On the day yisi he ascended the imperial throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he took the throne at the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 丁未，始聽政。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei he began to hear affairs of government.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he began to hold court.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷獻祥瑞。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu presentation of auspicious omens was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the court stopped accepting auspicious omens.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，劍南西川節度使韋皐卒，行軍司馬劉闢自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day guichou the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Wei Gao died; the campaign staff officer Liu Pi styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Wei Gao of western Sichuan died; Liu Pi, campaign staff officer, declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，天有聲于西北。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu there was a sound in heaven in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu a sound was heard in the sky from the northwest.

sentences.zh: 己未，袁滋為劍南西川、山南西道安撫大使。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei Yuan Zi was made pacification commissioner of Jiannan West and Shannan West.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yuan Zi was made pacification commissioner for western Sichuan and Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書左丞鄭餘慶同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the left director of the Department of State Affairs Zheng Yuqing was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Zheng Yuqing, left director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，罷教坊樂工正員官。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jisi the regular posts of Pear Garden musicians were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jisi regular Pear Garden musician posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，為曾太皇太后舉哀。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou mourning was held for the late grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingyou mourning was held for the late grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 賈耽薨。

translations.literal: Jia Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Dan died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，舒王誼薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Prince of Shu Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince of Shu Yi died.

sentences.zh: 袁滋罷。

translations.literal: Yuan Zi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己酉，葬神武聖文皇帝于崇陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the Divine Martial and Sagely Civil emperor was buried at Chong tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Dezong was buried at Chong Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，祔睿真皇后于元陵寢宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jisi Empress Ruizhen was enshrined at the sleeping palace of Yuan tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jisi Empress Ruizhen was enshrined at Yuan Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 壬申，貶韋執誼為崖州司馬。

translations.literal: On the day renshen Wei Zhiyi was demoted to aide of Ya prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wei Zhiyi was demoted to aide of Ya.

sentences.zh: 夏綏銀節度留後楊惠琳反。

translations.literal: The Yan-Sui-Yin acting commissioner Yang Huiling rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Huiling, acting commissioner of Yan-Sui-Yin, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，中書舍人鄭絪為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renxu the secretariat drafting officer Zheng Qiong was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renxu Zheng Qiong, secretariat drafting officer, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 元和元年正月丁卯，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanhe on the day dingmao there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanhe 1, on dingmao, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵，民高年者米帛羊酒。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, merit records, and titles; commoners of advanced age received grain, silk, sheep, and wine.
translations.idiomatic: Officials received ranks, merit, and titles; the elderly received grain, silk, sheep, and wine.

sentences.zh: 癸未，長武城使高崇文為左神策行營節度使，率左右神策京西行營兵馬使李元奕、山南西道節度使嚴礪、劍南東川節度使李康以討劉闢。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei the Changwu city envoy Gao Chongwen was made left Shence campaign military commissioner; he led the left and right Shence western capital campaign horse-and-army envoy Li Yuanyi, the Shannan West circuit military commissioner Yan Li, and the Jiannan East circuit military commissioner Li Kang to campaign against Liu Pi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Gao Chongwen, envoy of Changwu, was made left Shence campaign commissioner and led Li Yuanyi of the Shence western campaign, Yan Li of Shannan West, and Li Kang of eastern Sichuan against Liu Pi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太上皇崩。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen the Retired Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Retired Emperor died.

sentences.zh: 劉闢陷梓州，執李康。

translations.literal: Liu Pi took Zi prefecture and seized Li Kang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Pi captured Zi and seized Li Kang.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，高崇文克梓州。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day bingzi Gao Chongwen took Zi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingzi Gao Chongwen recovered Zi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，楊惠琳伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi Yang Huiling was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yang Huiling was executed.

sentences.zh: 四月丁未，杜佑為司徒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingwei Du You was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingwei Du You was appointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，邵王約薨。

translations.literal: On the day renxu Prince of Shao Yue died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Prince of Shao Yue died.

sentences.zh: 初令尚書省六品、諸司四品以上職事官，太子師傅、賓客、詹事，王府傅，日二人待制。

translations.literal: For the first time it was ordered that duty-holding officials of the sixth rank and above in the Secretariat and Department of State Affairs, the heir apparent's tutors, guests, and aides, and princely household tutors, two each day would attend on call.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time two Secretariat and Department officials of the sixth rank or higher, heir apparent tutors and aides, and princely tutors were ordered to attend on call each day.

sentences.zh: 五月辛卯，尊母為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinmao the mother was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinmao his mother was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，降死罪以下。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guisi death sentences and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guisi death sentences and below were reduced.

sentences.zh: 賜百姓有父母祖父母八十以上者粟二斛、物二段，九十以上粟三斛、物三段。

translations.literal: Commoners with parents or grandparents eighty and above received two piculs of grain and two bolts of goods; ninety and above three piculs and three bolts.
translations.idiomatic: Households with elders eighty or older received two piculs of grain and two bolts of goods; those ninety or older, three of each.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen a violent wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，高崇文及劉闢戰于鹿頭柵，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou Gao Chongwen and Liu Pi fought at Lutou stockade and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Gao Chongwen defeated Liu Pi at Lutou Stockade.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，嚴礪又敗之于石碑谷。

translations.literal: On the day guimao Yan Li again defeated him at Stone tablet valley.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Yan Li defeated him again at Shibei Valley.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬戌，平盧軍節度使李師古卒，其弟師道自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day renxu the Pinglu army military commissioner Li Shigu died; his younger brother Shidao styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on renxu Li Shigu of Pinglu died; his younger brother Shidao declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 七月壬寅，葬至德大聖大安孝皇帝于豐陵。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renyin the Supreme Virtue, Great Sagely, Great Peace, and Filial emperor was buried at Feng tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renyin Shunzong was buried at Feng Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，高崇文及劉闢戰于玄武，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Gao Chongwen and Liu Pi fought at Xuanwu and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Gao Chongwen defeated Liu Pi at Xuanwu.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，進封子平原郡王寧為鄧王，同安郡王寬澧王，延安郡王宥遂王，彭城郡王察深王，高密郡王寰洋王，文安郡王寮絳王；

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingmao the son Prince of Pingyuan commandery Ning was advanced to Prince of Deng; Prince of Tong'an commandery Kuan Prince of Li; Prince of Yan'an commandery You Prince of Sui; Prince of Pengcheng commandery Cha Prince of Shen; Prince of Gaomi commandery Huan Prince of Yang; Prince of Wen'an commandery Liao Prince of Jiang;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingmao his sons Ning, Kuan, You, Cha, Huan, and Liao were promoted or enfeoffed as Princes of Deng, Li, Sui, Shen, Yang, and Jiang;

sentences.zh: 封子審為建王。

translations.literal: the son Shen was enfeoffed Prince of Jian.
translations.idiomatic: and Shen was enfeoffed Prince of Jian.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，嚴礪及劉闢戰于神泉，敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingwu Yan Li and Liu Pi fought at Shen spring and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingwu Yan Li defeated Liu Pi at Shen Spring.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，高崇文克成都。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Gao Chongwen took Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Gao Chongwen took Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，減劍南東西川、山南西道今歲賦，釋脅從將吏。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiazi this year's tax of Jiannan East and West and Shannan West was reduced; coerced followers and officers were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiazi this year's taxes in eastern and western Sichuan and Shannan West were reduced and coerced followers released.

sentences.zh: 葬陣亡者，稟其家五歲。

translations.literal: Those who died in the array were buried; their families were provisioned for five years.
translations.idiomatic: The battle dead were buried and their families provisioned for five years.

sentences.zh: 戊子，劉闢伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Liu Pi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Pi was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，鄭餘慶罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengxu Zheng Yuqing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengxu Zheng Yuqing was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 是歲，召王偲薨。

translations.literal: That year Prince of Zhao Si died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Prince of Zhao Si died.

sentences.zh: 二年正月己丑，朝獻于太清宮。

translations.literal: In the second year in the first month on the day jichou offering was made at the Supreme Clear palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year, on jichou, the emperor offered at the Supreme Clear Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，朝享于太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin offering was made at the Imperial Ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，有事于南郊，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the southern suburban rite was performed; there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he performed the southern suburban rite and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官勳、爵，文宣公、二王後、三恪、公主、諸王一子官，高年米帛羊酒加版授。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted merit records and titles; one son of the Duke of Wenxuan, the two kings' descendants, the three Kek, princesses, and princes received office; the advanced aged received grain, silk, sheep, wine, and honorary appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Officials received merit and titles; sons of the Duke of Wenxuan, two kings' descendants, three Kek, princesses, and princes received office; the elderly received provisions and honorary rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，杜黃裳罷。

translations.literal: On the day yisi Du Huangxiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Du Huangxiang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己酉，御史中丞武元衡為門下侍郎，中書舍人李吉甫為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the vice censor-in-chief Wu Yuanheng was made vice director of the Chancellery; the secretariat drafting officer Li Jifu was made vice secretary of the Secretariat: Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Wu Yuanheng, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Li Jifu, secretariat drafting officer, vice secretary—both as Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，罷兩省官次對。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jisi sequential memorials at the two departments were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jisi sequential memorials at the Secretariat and Chancellery were ended.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，邕管經略使路恕敗黃洞蠻，執其首領黃承慶。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the Yongguan frontier commissioner Lu Shu defeated the Huangdong cave barbarians and seized their leader Huang Chengqing.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Lu Shu of Yongguan defeated the Huangdong cave tribes and captured their leader Huang Chengqing.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，密王綢薨。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day yiyou Prince of Mi Chou died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yiyou Prince of Mi Chou died.

sentences.zh: 十月，鎮海軍節度使李錡反，殺留後王澹。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Zhenhai army military commissioner Li Qi rebelled and killed the acting commissioner Wang Dan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Li Qi of Zhenhai rebelled and killed acting commissioner Wang Dan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，淮南節度使王鍔為諸道行營兵馬招討使以討之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the Huainan military commissioner Wang E was made commander to recruit troops of the circuits' campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang E of Huainan was made commander to recruit coalition forces against Li Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，武元衡罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Wu Yuanheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wu Yuanheng was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，鎮海軍兵馬使張子良執李錡。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the Zhenhai army horse-and-army envoy Zhang Ziliang seized Li Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhang Ziliang of Zhenhai seized Li Qi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，免潤州今歲稅。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Run prefecture's tax for this year was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Run's current tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，李錡伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiashen Li Qi was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiashen Li Qi was executed.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，劍南西川節度使高崇文為邠寧節度、京西諸軍都統。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day bingyin the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Gao Chongwen was made Bin-Ning military commissioner and overall commander of western capital armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingyin Gao Chongwen of western Sichuan was made commissioner of Bin-Ning and overall commander of western capital forces.

sentences.zh: 三年正月癸巳，羣臣上尊號曰睿聖文武皇帝，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year on the day guisi the ministers presented an honorific title saying Sagely Civil and Martial emperor; there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on guisi, the ministers offered the honorific Sagely Civil and Martial Emperor and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 罷諸道受代進奉錢。

translations.literal: Tribute money from circuits on succession was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Succession tribute payments from the circuits were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，郇王緫薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day guisi Prince of Xun Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on guisi Prince of Xun Zong died.

sentences.zh: 四月壬申，大風壞含元殿西闕檻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day renshen a great wind destroyed the western gate railing of the Hall of Universal Origin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renshen a violent wind destroyed the western gate railing of the Hall of Universal Origin.

sentences.zh: 六月，西原蠻首領黃少卿降。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the western plain barbarian leader Huang Shaoqing surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Huang Shaoqing, western plain leader, surrendered.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the first day of the month xinsi there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，山南東道節度使于頔為司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengyin the Shannan East circuit military commissioner Yu Di was made minister of works and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengyin Yu Di of Shannan East was appointed minister of works and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，戶部侍郎裴垍為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen the vice minister of revenue Pei Ji was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Pei Ji, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，李吉甫罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Li Jifu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Jifu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 四年正月壬午，免山南東道、淮南、江西、浙東、湖南、荊南今歲稅。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year on the day renwu tax was remitted for Shannan East, Huainan, Jiangxi, eastern Zhejiang, Hunan, and Jingnan this year.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year, on renwu, this year's taxes were remitted for Shannan East, Huainan, Jiangxi, eastern Zhejiang, Hunan, and Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，簡王遘薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Prince of Jian Gou died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Prince of Jian Gou died.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，鄭絪罷。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingmao Zheng Qiong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingmao Zheng Qiong was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 給事中李藩為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: The supervising secretary Li Fan was made vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan, supervising secretary, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，成德軍節度使王士真卒，其子承宗自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day yiyou the Chengde army military commissioner Wang Shizhen died; his son Chengzong styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yiyou Wang Shizhen of Chengde died; his son Chengzong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，以旱降京師死罪非殺人者，禁刺史境內榷率、諸道旨條外進獻、嶺南黔中福建掠良民為奴婢者，省飛龍廄馬。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day jiyou because of drought death sentences in the capital except for murder were reduced; commissioners' monopoly levies within their circuits, extra tribute beyond directives, and Lingnan, Qianzhong, and Fujian seizing good commoners as slaves were forbidden; Flying Dragon stable horses were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on jiyou, because of drought, capital death sentences except murder were reduced; circuit monopoly levies, extra tribute, and enslavement of commoners in Lingnan, Qianzhong, and Fujian were forbidden; Flying Dragon stable horses were reduced.

sentences.zh: 己未，雨。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei rain fell.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，立鄧王寧為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao Prince of Deng Ning was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince of Deng Ning was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥，吐蕃請和。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day guihai Tibet requested peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on guihai Tibet sought peace.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，環王寇安南，都護張舟敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingshen the king of Huan raided Annan; the protector Zhang Zhou defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingshen the king of Huan raided Annan; Protector Zhang Zhou repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，成德軍節度使王承宗反，執保信軍節度使薛昌朝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinsi the Chengde army military commissioner Wang Chengzong rebelled and seized the Baoxin army military commissioner Xue Changchao.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinsi Wang Chengzong of Chengde rebelled and seized Xue Changchao of Baoxin.

sentences.zh: 癸未，左神策軍護軍中尉吐突承璀為左右神策、河陽、浙西、宣歙、鎮州行營兵馬招討處置使以討之。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei the left Shence army supervising army commissioner Tu Tu Chenghuan was made commander to recruit and dispose troops of the left and right Shence, Heyang, Zhexi, Xuan-She, and Zhen prefecture campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Tu Tu Chenghuan, left Shence supervising commissioner, was made commander of Shence, Heyang, Zhexi, Xuan-She, and Zhen campaign forces.

sentences.zh: 戊子，承璀為鎮州招討宣慰使。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Chenghuan was made pacification envoy of Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Chenghuan was made pacification envoy of Zhen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，降死罪以下，賜文武官子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: On the day guisi death sentences and below were reduced; civil and military officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi death sentences and below were reduced; officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，彰義軍節度使吳少誠卒，其弟少陽自稱留後。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jisi the Zhangyi army military commissioner Wu Shaoqing died; his younger brother Shaoyang styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jisi Wu Shaoqing of Zhangyi died; his younger brother Shaoyang declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 五年正月己巳，左神策軍大將軍酈定進及王承宗戰，死之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year on the day jisi the left Shence army great general Li Dingjin and Wang Chengzong fought and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year, on jisi, Li Dingjin of the left Shence army fought Wang Chengzong and was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，大風拔木。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiazi a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi a violent wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，河東節度使范希朝、義武軍節度使張茂昭及王承宗戰于木刀溝，敗之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dinghai the Hedong military commissioner Fan Xichao, the Yicheng army military commissioner Zhang Maozhao, and Wang Chengzong fought at Mudao gully and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dinghai Fan Xichao of Hedong and Zhang Maozhao of Yicheng defeated Wang Chengzong at Mudao Gully.

sentences.zh: 七月丁未，赦王承宗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dingwei Wang Chengzong was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingwei Wang Chengzong was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幽州盧龍軍節度使劉濟卒，其子緫自稱留後。

translations.literal: On the day yimao the Youzhou Lulong army military commissioner Liu Ji died; his son Zong styled himself acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Liu Ji of Lulong died; his son Zong declared himself acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，太常卿權德輿為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingyin the minister of sacrifices Quan Deyu was made minister of rites and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingyin Quan Deyu, minister of sacrifices, was appointed minister of rites and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月，張茂昭以易、定二州歸于有司。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Zhang Maozhao returned Yi and Ding prefectures to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zhang Maozhao returned Yi and Ding to imperial control.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，義武軍都虞候楊伯玉反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the Yicheng army chief aide Yang Boyu rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yang Boyu, chief aide of Yicheng, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，義武軍兵馬使張佐元反，伏誅。

translations.literal: That month the Yicheng army horse-and-army envoy Zhang Zuoyuan rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhang Zuoyuan, Yicheng horse-and-army envoy, rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰，會王纁薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiachen Prince of Hui Xu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiachen Prince of Hui Xu died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，裴垍罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen Pei Ji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Pei Ji was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 六年正月庚申，淮南節度使李吉甫為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year on the day gengshen the Huainan military commissioner Li Jifu was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year, on gengshen, Li Jifu of Huainan was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，李藩罷。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day renshen Li Fan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on renshen Li Fan was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 己丑，忻王造薨。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Prince of Xin Zao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Prince of Xin Zao died.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，有星隕于鄆州。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day wuxu a star fell at Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wuxu a meteor fell at Yan.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，戶部侍郎李絳為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jichou the vice minister of revenue Li Jiang was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jichou Li Jiang, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛卯，辰、漵州首領張伯靖反，寇播、費二州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day xinmao the Chen and Xu prefecture leader Zhang Bojing rebelled and raided Bo and Fei prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on xinmao Zhang Bojing of Chen and Xu rebelled and raided Bo and Fei.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，皇太子薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the heir apparent died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the heir apparent died.

sentences.zh: 七年正月癸酉，振武河溢，毀東受降城。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year on the day guiyou the Zhenwu river overflowed and destroyed the eastern surrender city.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the seventh year, on guiyou, the Zhenwu River flooded and destroyed the eastern surrender city.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳，詔民田畝樹桑二。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day guisi it was decreed that each mu of commoners' fields plant two mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on guisi the court ordered two mulberry trees planted per mu of household land.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，杜佑罷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guisi Du You was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guisi Du You was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，立遂王宥為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yihai Prince of Sui You was established as heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yihai Prince of Sui You was installed as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，魏博節度使田季安卒，其子懷諫自稱知軍府事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day wuxu the Weibo military commissioner Tian Ji'an died; his son Huaijian styled himself in charge of the military government.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on wuxu Tian Ji'an of Weibo died; his son Huaijian took charge of the military government.

sentences.zh: 九月，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the capital was shaken.

sentences.zh: 十月乙未，魏博軍以田季安之將田興知軍事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day yiwei the Weibo army made Tian Ji'an's general Tian Xing in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on yiwei the Weibo army placed Tian Xing, a general of Tian Ji'an, in charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，降死罪以下，賜文武官子為父後者勳兩轉。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu death sentences and below were reduced; civil and military officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu death sentences and below were reduced; officials' sons succeeding fathers received two merit rotations.

sentences.zh: 是月，魏博節度使田興以六州歸于有司。

translations.literal: That month the Weibo military commissioner Tian Xing returned six prefectures to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tian Xing of Weibo returned six prefectures to imperial control.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，赦魏、博、貝、衞、澶、相六州，給復一年，賜高年、孤獨、廢疾粟帛，賞軍士。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinyou the six prefectures Wei, Bo, Bei, Wei, Cao, and Xiang were pardoned; tax relief for one year; grain and silk to the aged, orphans, and disabled; soldiers rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinyou Wei, Bo, Bei, Wei, Cao, and Xiang were pardoned, granted one year's tax relief, and given grain and silk for the aged, orphans, and disabled; troops were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 八年正月辛未，權德輿罷。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year on the day xinwei Quan Deyu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, on xinwei, Quan Deyu was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，貶于頔為恩王傅。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingyou Yu Di was demoted to tutor of the Prince of En.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingyou Yu Di was demoted to tutor of the Prince of En.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，劍南西川節度使武元衡為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiazi the Jiannan West circuit military commissioner Wu Yuanheng was made vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi Wu Yuanheng of western Sichuan was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月己亥，黔中經略使崔能討張伯靖。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jihai the Qianzhong frontier commissioner Cui Neng campaigned against Zhang Bojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jihai Cui Neng of Qianzhong campaigned against Zhang Bojing.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，荊南節度使嚴綬討伯靖。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day guihai the Jingnan military commissioner Yan Shou campaigned against Bojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on guihai Yan Shou of Jingnan campaigned against Bojing.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大隗山崩。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou the great Wei mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Great Wei Mountain collapsed.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，渭水溢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinmao the Wei river overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinmao the Wei River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，出宮人。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，劍南東川節度使潘孟陽討張伯靖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jisi the Jiannan East circuit military commissioner Pan Mengyang campaigned against Zhang Bojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jisi Pan Mengyang of eastern Sichuan campaigned against Zhang Bojing.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，湖南觀察使柳公綽討伯靖。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinsi the Hunan observation commissioner Liu Gongchuo campaigned against Bojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinsi Liu Gongchuo of Hunan campaigned against Bojing.

sentences.zh: 丁未，伯靖降。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Bojing surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhang Bojing surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，振武將楊遵憲反，逐其節度使李進賢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengyin the Zhenwu general Yang Zunxian rebelled and drove out its military commissioner Li Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengyin Yang Zunxian of Zhenwu rebelled and expelled Li Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 九年二月癸卯，李絳罷。

translations.literal: In the ninth year in the second month on the day guimao Li Jiang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the ninth year, on guimao, Li Jiang was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，巂州地震。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day bingchen Yan prefecture earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingchen Yan was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，隕霜殺桑。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao frost killed mulberry trees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao late frost destroyed the mulberry crop.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，桂王綸薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day yichou Prince of Gui Lun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on yichou Prince of Gui Lun died.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以旱免京畿夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou because of drought the metropolitan summer tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the metropolitan summer tax was remitted because of drought.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，河中節度使張弘靖為刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day renyin the Hezhong military commissioner Zhang Hongjing was made vice minister of justice and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on renyin Zhang Hongjing of Hezhong was appointed vice minister of justice and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏八月丙辰，彰義軍節度使吳少陽卒，其子元濟自稱知軍事。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month on the day bingchen the Zhangyi army military commissioner Wu Shaoyang died; his son Yuanji styled himself in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month on bingchen Wu Shaoyang of Zhangyi died; his son Yuanji took charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，山南東道節度使嚴綬、忠武軍都知兵馬使李光顏、壽州團練使李文通、河陽節度使烏重胤討之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dinghai the Shannan East circuit military commissioner Yan Shou, the Zhongwu army overall horse-and-army envoy Li Guangyan, the Shou prefecture training commissioner Li Wentong, and the Heyang military commissioner Wu Zhongyin campaigned against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dinghai Yan Shou of Shannan East, Li Guangyan of Zhongwu, Li Wentong of Shou, and Wu Zhongyin of Heyang were sent against Wu Yuanji.

sentences.zh: 十月，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丙午，李吉甫薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu Li Jifu died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Li Jifu died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，嚴綬為申、光、蔡招撫使。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi Yan Shou was made pacification commissioner of Shen, Guang, and Cai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Yan Shou was made pacification commissioner of Shen, Guang, and Cai.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，罷京兆府臘獻狐兔。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day wuzi the metropolitan winter offering of fox and hare was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on wuzi the metropolitan winter offering of fox and hare was ended.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔刑部、大理官朔望入對。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month it was decreed that justice and grand justice officials attend on the first and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month justice and grand justice officials were ordered to attend court on the first and fifteenth.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，尚書右丞韋貫之同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the right director of the Department of State Affairs Wei Guanzhi was made Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Wei Guanzhi, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十年正月乙酉，宣武軍節度使韓弘為司徒。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year on the day yiyou the Xuanwu army military commissioner Han Hong was made grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, on yiyou, Han Hong of Xuanwu was appointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，嚴綬及吳元濟戰于磁丘，敗績。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiachen Yan Shou and Wu Yuanji fought at Ciciu and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiachen Yan Shou fought Wu Yuanji at Ciciu and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 自冬不雨至于是月。

translations.literal: From winter no snow until this month.
translations.idiomatic: From winter until this month no snow had fallen.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雪。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu snow fell at last.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，河東戍將劉輔殺豐州刺史燕重旰，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renxu the Hedong garrison general Liu Fu killed the Feng prefecture inspector Yan Chonggan and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Liu Fu, Hedong garrison general, killed Yan Chonggan, inspector of Feng, and was executed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，忠武軍節度使李光顏及吳元濟戰于臨潁，敗之。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day gengzi the Zhongwu army military commissioner Li Guangyan and Wu Yuanji fought at Linying and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on gengzi Li Guangyan of Zhongwu defeated Wu Yuanji at Linying.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，又敗之于南頓。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiachen he again defeated him at Nandun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiachen he defeated him again at Nandun.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，又敗之于時曲。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingshen he again defeated him at Shiqu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingshen he defeated him again at Shiqu.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，盜殺武元衡。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guimao Wu Yuanheng was killed by assassins.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guimao Wu Yuanheng was assassinated.

sentences.zh: 戊申，京師大索。

translations.literal: On the day wushen a great search was made in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the capital was subjected to a sweeping search.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，御史中丞裴度為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the vice censor-in-chief Pei Du was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Pei Du, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed vice secretary and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月甲戌，王承宗有罪，絕其朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiaxu Wang Chengzong was guilty; his court tribute was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiaxu Wang Chengzong was declared guilty and his tribute missions were cut off.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the first day of the month jihai there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, jihai, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，李師道將訾嘉珍反于東都，留守呂元膺敗之。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei Li Shidao's general Zi Jiazhen rebelled at the eastern capital; the acting commissioner Lü Yuanying defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zi Jiazhen, a general of Li Shidao, rebelled at Luoyang; acting commissioner Lü Yuanying defeated him.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，李光顏及吳元濟戰于時曲，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day yichou Li Guangyan and Wu Yuanji fought at Shiqu and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Li Guangyan fought Wu Yuanji at Shiqu and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 九月癸酉，韓弘為淮西行營兵馬都統。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day guiyou Han Hong was made overall commander of the Huai West campaign horse-and-army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guiyou Han Hong was made overall commander of the Huai West campaign.

sentences.zh: 十月，地震。

translations.literal: In the tenth month there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，李光顏、烏重胤及吳元濟戰于小溵河，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen Li Guangyan, Wu Zhongyin, and Wu Yuanji fought at Xiaoxun river and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen Li Guangyan and Wu Zhongyin defeated Wu Yuanji at Xiaoxun River.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李文通又敗之于固始。

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiawu the Wei River overflowed.

translations.idiomatic: On jiwei western plain tribes captured Yan.

translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year, on dingchou, there was an earthquake.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Yong of Huainan was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Participating Secretary jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Pei Du was removed from office.

translations.idiomatic: On jichou the ministers offered the honorific Yuanhe Sagely Civil, Martial, Divine, Responsive to Heaven, and Accordant with the Way Emperor.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuyin Wang Bian was executed.

translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor died, aged forty-three, with the posthumous title Sagely Spirit, Martial, and Filial.
