translations.literal: In the third year of Dazhong the posthumous title was increased to Sagely Civil, Martial, Great Sagely, Supreme Spirit, and Filial emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong 3 his posthumous title was expanded to Sagely Civil, Martial, Great Sagely, Supreme Spirit, and Filial.

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：德宗猜忌刻薄，以彊明自任，恥見屈於正論，而忘受欺於姦諛。

translations.literal: [Appraisal] The appraisal says: Dezong was suspicious, jealous, and harsh; he took forceful clarity as his task, was shamed to be overcome by upright criticism, and forgot he was deceived by wicked flattery.
translations.idiomatic: [Appraisal] The appraisal says: Dezong was suspicious, harsh, and thin-skinned. Taking forceful clarity as his virtue, he resented upright criticism yet welcomed the flattery of schemers.

sentences.zh: 故其疑蕭復之輕己，謂姜公輔為賣直，而不能容；

translations.literal: Therefore his suspicion that Xiao Fu looked down on him, his saying Jiang Gongfu sold straight talk, and his inability to tolerate them;
translations.idiomatic: Hence his suspicion of Xiao Fu's disdain, his charge that Jiang Gongfu peddled blunt honesty, and his refusal to tolerate either;

sentences.zh: 用盧𣏌、趙贊，則至於敗亂，而終不悔。

translations.literal: employing Lu Qi and Zhao Zan, then reaching defeat and disorder, yet in the end not repenting.
translations.idiomatic: yet his use of Lu Qi and Zhao Zan led to defeat and chaos without final repentance.

sentences.zh: 及奉天之難，深自懲艾，遂行姑息之政。

translations.literal: When the Fengtian crisis came he deeply punished himself and then pursued an indulgent policy.
translations.idiomatic: After the Fengtian crisis he punished himself deeply, then pursued an indulgent policy.

sentences.zh: 由是朝廷益弱，而方鎮愈彊，至於唐亡，其患以此。

translations.literal: Because of this the court grew weaker while the frontier commands grew stronger; down to Tang's fall the harm arose from this.
translations.idiomatic: The court thus weakened while frontier commands grew stronger; Tang's fall stemmed largely from this.

sentences.zh: 憲宗剛明果斷，自初即位，慨然發憤，志平僭叛，能用忠謀，不惑羣議，卒收成功。

translations.literal: Xianzong was firm, bright, and decisive; from his first accession he sighed and roused his spirit, resolved to pacify usurpers, able to use loyal counsel, not confused by crowd opinion, and in the end achieved success.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong was firm, bright, and decisive. From his accession he burned to pacify rebellion, heeded loyal counsel, ignored clamor, and ultimately succeeded.

sentences.zh: 自吳元濟誅，彊藩悍將皆欲悔過而効順。

translations.literal: From Wu Yuanji's execution the strong commands and fierce generals all wished to repent and submit.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Yuanji's execution powerful commands and fierce generals sought to repent and submit.

sentences.zh: 當此之時，唐之威令，幾於復振，則其為優劣，不待較而可知也。

translations.literal: At that time Tang's authority and orders nearly revived; then whether one was superior or inferior need not be compared to know.
translations.idiomatic: Tang authority nearly revived; their relative merit scarcely needs comparison.

sentences.zh: 及其晚節，信用非人，不終其業，而身罹不測之禍，則尤甚於德宗。

translations.literal: Reaching his late years he trusted unfit men, did not finish his work, and himself suffered unforeseen calamity—then especially worse than Dezong.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in his late years he trusted unfit men, left his work unfinished, and died by unforeseen violence—worse, in that respect, than Dezong.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 小人之能敗國也，不必愚君暗主，雖聰明聖智，苟有惑焉，未有不為患者也。

translations.literal: Small men's power to ruin a state need not be foolish or dark rulers; even bright and sage rulers, if there is delusion, none fail to suffer harm.
translations.idiomatic: Small men can ruin a state without foolish or dark rulers; even sage emperors, once deluded, suffer harm.

sentences.zh: 昔韓愈言，順宗在東宮二十年，天下陰受其賜。

translations.literal: Formerly Han Yu said that in the twenty years Shunzong was heir apparent the realm secretly received his benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu once said that during Shunzong's twenty years as heir apparent the realm secretly benefited from him.

sentences.zh: 然享國日淺，不幸疾病，莫克有為，亦可以悲夫！

translations.literal: Yet his enjoyment of the state was brief; unhappily ill, unable to accomplish his aims—this too may be lamented!
translations.idiomatic: Yet his reign was brief; illness kept him from achieving his aims—a cause for lament.
